Description:

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.
  
  
As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.
  
  
The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

* Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
* Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
* Exceptional English & Arabic communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.

* Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.

* +2 years in the Salesforce Ecosystem.

* Knowledge of Salesforce products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy.

Title: Partner Account Executive
Description:
The Role
  
  
The MSP Sales& Go-to-Market Lead – MEA-TRC East is an individual contributor responsible for accelerating and scaling Splunk’s business with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) across the region.
  
  
This role translates the broader EMEA MSP strategy into a focused regional go-to-market and sales execution plan. The successful candidate will support the development and growth of strategic MSP partnerships that generate sustainable pipeline, recurring revenue, and new customer acquisition for Splunk.
  
The role will drive the adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program and ensure that Splunk is embedded or “designed in” within partners’ managed security, observability, infrastructure, and digital-resilience service offerings.
  
The MSP Sales& Go-to-Market Lead does not own or manage the partner relationship. Partner ownership and accountability remain with the respective Partner Development Manager (PDM) or Partner Sales Manager (PSM). This role provides MSP expertise, direction, and execution support to help partner and sales teams build and scale successful MSP motions.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
Regional MSP Strategy and Go-to-Market
  
  

* Develop and execute the regional MSP sales and go-to-market plan, aligned with the overall EMEA MSP strategy and regional business priorities.
* Ensure that priority partners have a clear MSP strategy and execution plan embedded within the broader partner plans owned by the respective PDMs and PSMs.
* Support PDMs and PSMs in defining MSP growth plans, revenue ambitions, enablement requirements, service-development priorities, and joint go-to-market activities.
* Build a clear scale plan to expand the regional MSP ecosystem by onboarding new partners, growing existing MSP capabilities, and driving new customer acquisition.
* Identify priority markets, customer segments, industry verticals, and MSP propositions with the strongest potential for scalable growth.
* Maintain a strong understanding of regional market dynamics, competition, regulation, customer demand, and emerging managed-service trends.

Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support and drive MSP-related sales and business development activities across the region in close collaboration with PDMs, PSMs, and Splunk sales teams.
* Develop campaigns and initiatives that create MSP pipeline, generate net-new logos, and support recurring-revenue growth.
* Maintain visibility of the regional MSP pipeline and regularly review progress, performance, and execution with sales and partner teams.
* Support joint account planning and opportunity development with key strategic MSP partners.
* Work closely with regional and global MSP sales teams to align priorities, share best practices, and accelerate strategic opportunities.
* Support complex MSP opportunities and collaborate with the EMEA team to remove commercial, operational, contractual, or organizational barriers.
* Ensure that partner ownership, execution accountability, and opportunity follow-up remain clearly assigned to the relevant PDM, PSM, and sales teams.

Splunk MSP Program and Enablement
  
  

* Lead the regional adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program.
* Act as the regional MSP subject-matter expert and advocate for the program across partner and sales organizations.
* Advise internal teams and partners on MSP commercial models, pricing, contracting, licensing, and partner economics.
* Educate and enable Splunk sales, partner, and technical teams on the MSP route to market and how to position and execute the program.
* Work closely with the EMEA MSP team to identify program improvements required to address regional market needs.
* Partner closely with the MSP Partner Technical Manager (PTM) to ensure that the regional plan is technically aligned and supported by the required enablement, service-development, and delivery capabilities.

GTMDevelopmentandCross-FunctionalAlignment
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with key MSP stakeholders across executive leadership, sales, technical, service-development, operations, and marketing teams.
* Support partners in developing and launching differentiated Splunk-powered managed services.
* Help ensure that Splunk is designed into partners’ service catalogues across security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, and digital resilience.
* Support the development of partner value propositions, business cases, sales plays, campaigns, and customer-facing propositions.
* Align with Splunk Regional Sales Directors, Regional Sales Managers, AVPs, partner leadership, and other senior stakeholders.
* Work closely with PDMs, PSMs, PTMs, marketing, legal, finance, operations, and the EMEA and global MSP teams.
* Prepare and deliver MSP business reviews and updates to regional, EMEA, and partner leadership teams.

Commercial Leadership and Negotiation
  
  

* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with MSP and MSSP partners.
* Work with the EMEA MSP team, legal, finance, pricing, operations, and deal-desk teams to develop scalable and commercially viable agreements.
* Help resolve complex pricing, licensing, contractual, and route-to-market considerations.
* Apply strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills to accelerate strategic opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working with MSPs, MSSPs, service providers, cloud providers, or technology partners.
* Deep understanding of the regional MSP and MSSP landscape, business models, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics.
* Demonstrated success in sales, business development, partner development, or go-to-market roles.
* Proven ability to translate regional strategies into executable partner and sales plans.
* Strong understanding of recurring-revenue, consumption-based, managed-service, and partner-led business models.
* Experience developing and launching partner-led managed services or technology-based service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting complex pricing, contracting, and negotiation discussions.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across partner, sales, technical, executive, regional, and global teams without direct ownership.

Title: Client Business Executive - CSS KSA
Description:

-------------------------

The Client Business Executive is accountable for the end-to-end CSS business within the assigned customer unit or cluster. The role owns the business agenda across pre-sales, solution positioning, sales execution, delivery alignment, customer satisfaction, and profitable growth.

As the primary CSS business leader toward the Cluster Heads, the Client Business Executive translates customer and business priorities into clear growth strategies, investment decisions, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. The role requires strong commercial judgment, customer intimacy, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to make timely decisions across a complex, geographically diverse organization.

The Client Business Executive works closely with KAMs, Customer Unit leadership, Solution Areas, delivery organizations, commercial functions, partners, and senior customer stakeholders to grow the CSS business across the complete customer lifecycle.

**Business and Financial Accountability**

* Own the CSS business plan and performance objectives for the assigned customer unit cluster.
* Drive profitable growth through new business, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, transformation programs, and improved customer retention.
* Monitor business performance, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, delivery economics, customer satisfaction, risks, and profitability.
* Ensure disciplined governance of commercial commitments, resources, investments, costs, and business risks.
* Convert customer relationships and market insight into concrete sales results and sustainable business outcomes.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead and influence cross-functional teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, innovation, and results orientation across the CSS organization and its interfaces.
* Align diverse teams around common customer outcomes, clear priorities, and measurable execution plans.
* Coach and develop leaders and key contributors across sales, pre-sales, delivery, service management, and supporting functions.
* Promote knowledge sharing, best-practice reuse, talent development, and strong succession planning.
* Represent the CSS organization with credibility and executive presence in internal and external forums.

**Key Interfaces**

* Cluster Heads and Customer Unit leadership
* Key Account Managers and Account Teams
* Senior customer executives and buying centers
* CSS sales, pre-sales, solution architecture, and delivery organizations
* Service management, fulfillment, assurance, and operations teams
* Solution Areas and Business Areas
* Commercial management, finance, legal, and procurement
* Strategic partners and third-party suppliers

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Own the end-to-end CSS business within the assigned customer unit or cluster, with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, and overall business results.
* Act as the primary CSS business interface toward Cluster Heads, Customer Unit leadership, KAMs, and relevant Solution Area leaders.
* Develop and execute a CSS growth strategy covering customer priorities, market opportunities, portfolio development, pipeline creation, account planning, and long-term business transformation.
* Lead the CSS business agenda across the full lifecycle, from early customer engagement and opportunity shaping through pre-sales, contracting, delivery, adoption, value realization, renewal, upsell, and cross-sell.
* Take ownership of key business decisions across pre-sales and delivery, balancing customer value, commercial opportunities, delivery feasibility, risk, quality, resource requirements, and profitability.
* Drive executive-level customer engagement with CIOs, CTOs, operations leaders, procurement stakeholders, and other senior decision-makers to understand business priorities and position relevant CSS solutions and services.
* Identify customer business needs and translate them into practical, scalable, and de-risked solution approaches that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Build and manage a healthy CSS funnel through proactive, data-driven opportunity identification, early engagement, consultative selling, and disciplined pipeline governance.
* Lead the development of customer engagement plans, growth plans, account strategies, and opportunity execution plans in collaboration with KAMs and cross-functional teams.
* Ensure high-quality proposals, solution positioning, commercial models, costing, pricing, governance, and executive communications throughout the sales cycle.
* Establish strong alignment between sales, pre-sales, solution architecture, delivery, service management, commercial management, finance, partners, and customer stakeholders.
* Maintain accountability for delivery readiness and customer value realization, ensuring that commitments made during the sales process are understood, managed, and delivered effectively.
* Act as a senior escalation point for significant customer, commercial, delivery, quality, and relationship issues within the CSS scope.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, digitalization, standardized ways of working, performance transparency, knowledge reuse, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with partners and internal organizations to strengthen the end-to-end CSS offering and expand the value delivered to customers.

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

Title: Delivery Program Director
Description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

* Degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field. ITIL or customer success certification is a plus.

Title: Head of IT Security
Description:
Job Description:

* Security by design: security requirements, architecture reviews and testing embedded in digital, cloud and AI projects before go-live
* Regulatory and certification compliance: clean audit outcomes against QCB, NCSA and ISO 27001 / PCI DSS requirements, and timely closure of findings
* Data protection controls (DLP, encryption, email and web security) protecting customer and corporate data
* Security awareness, phishing resilience and a well-structured, capable IT Security team
* Lead the IT Security function under the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer, alongside Head of Group IT and Head of Data & AI
* Owns first-line security controls and operations; works with the Cyber Security & Data Protection Officer (Group Risk) who owns security policy, risk appetite and second-line oversight
* Engages directly with Group IT, Data & AI, digital product teams, business units, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Legal and external vendors
* Operates information security policies, risk and compliance frameworks, and the requirements of QCB, NCSA (National Information Assurance standard), Qatar's personal data protection law and other applicable regulators
* Functions in a fast-changing environment of cloud adoption, digital ecosystem launches and AI deployment, with a 24/7 threat landscape
* Significant autonomy over security architecture, tooling and operations; escalates major incidents, material risks and risk acceptances to the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer and Group Risk
* Prioritizes security investments and remediation across a broad estate with finite budget, people and change windows
* Leads the response to live security incidents under time pressure — containment, forensics, recovery and lessons learned
* Balances strong controls with business agility, enabling digital and AI initiatives without creating unmanaged risk
* Assesses the security of new technologies (cloud services, APIs, third-party platforms, generative AI) and designs proportionate controls
* Interprets regulatory and audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions and translates them into practical technical controls
* Manages third-party and supply-chain security risk across technology vendors and outsourced services
* Translates technical threat and vulnerability data into clear, risk-based messages for executives and committee
* Defines IT security architecture, technical standards and baseline configurations for the Group's technology estate
* Selects security tools and managed-security providers and manages the security budget within delegated authority
* Approves or blocks go-live of systems and changes based on security review outcomes, within the agreed governance framework
* Directs incident response, including containment actions such as isolating systems or disabling compromised accounts
* Sets remediation priorities and deadlines for vulnerabilities and audit findings with Group IT and application owners
* Hires, develops and manages the performance of the IT Security team, in line with HR policies

Educational Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field
* Master's degree in Information Security or a related field is preferred
* Professional security certification (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP or equivalent) strongly preferred; vendor certifications (e.g. Fortinet, Microsoft, cloud security) are an advantage

Experience:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT, with at least 5 years in information / cyber security
* Minimum 3 years leading an IT security or cybersecurity team, including SOC or security operations
* Proven track record in financial services (insurance, banking, payments or fintech) or another regulated industry
* Hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies: firewalls / NGFW, SIEM, EDR, WAF, DLP,IAM / PAM
* Experience leading ISO 27001 and / or PCI DSS compliance and regulatory or external audits
* Experience managing managed-security providers and international technology vendors • GCC / Qatar regulatory exposure (QCB, NCSA) is a strong plus; insurance industry experience is an advantage

The Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring owns the operational management and health of IMCO’s enterprise AI platforms, with a focus on observability, reliability, performance, usage and cost. * Establish and manage enterprise observability and monitoring capabilities across Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform AI services, and future AI platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve monitoring and observability across AI platforms, models and agents, including performance, reliability, agent activity, usage and operational risks.
* Develop dashboards, alerts and KPIs that provide visibility into platform health, adoption, usage, capacity and cost.
* Identify and coordinate resolution of platform incidents and production issues, maintaining appropriate runbooks, support procedures and service expectations.

**Platform Management & Controls**

* Establish and maintain platform standards covering environments, connectors, capacity, solution management and enterprise use of Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Implement and operate platform controls and guardrails aligned with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Privacy and Technology Risk requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access, environment and platform management practices to support secure and scalable use.

Title: VP, Delivery and Customer Success
Description:
**About Us**
Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As Vice President, Customer Success, you'll take the lead on client health across Appficiency's global delivery portfolio. This is a customer-first leadership role: you'll be the face of delivery excellence for our most strategic accounts, spending your time where it counts most - with clients and the teams who serve them. You'll build the kind of trust that turns successful implementations into long-term partnerships, and set the standard the rest of the organization looks to for keeping engagements on scope, on time, on budget, and on quality. We're looking for a delivery leader who has built their career inside project implementation or customer success - someone who knows what it takes to earn a client's confidence and keep it.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own client health across your portfolio, building the kind of trust and consistency that keeps retention high and relationships strong for the long term
* Champion end-to-end delivery excellence, ensuring every engagement is meticulously planned, resourced, and executed within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standards
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic accounts, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor rather than just a delivery contact
* Match your team's skill set to the demands of each engagement, building and maintaining a resource pool capable of scaling with the business
* Identify skill gaps across the team both technical and interpersonal, and partner with fellow delivery leaders to close them through coaching, training, and targeted hiring
* Provide the kind of direction and constructive feedback that helps your team consistently hit customer success KPIs, not just individual project milestones
* Turn strong delivery into business growth, actively supporting the conversion of implementation engagements into follow-on opportunities
* Build a client base that is referenceable, ensuring your accounts become some of Appficiency's strongest references
* Manage your portfolio's profitability with the same rigor you apply to client satisfaction, balancing commercial outcomes with delivery excellence

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* A career built in delivery or project-implementation leadership and customer success ownership - you've sat close enough to execution to know what it actually takes to keep a client happy
* Direct experience owning the full client lifecycle post-go-live - hypercare transition, steady-state support, QBRs, renewal conversations, and escalation management
* Comfort operating with customer health metrics (NPS, CSAT, retention/churn) as core performance indicators, alongside traditional delivery metrics like scope, time, and budget
* 10+ years in Professional Services leadership, with 7-8 of those years hands-on in systems implementation, integration, or process re-engineering
* 8-10 years working across ERP and CRM platforms such as NetSuite and Salesforce; familiarity with AI-driven or productivity solutions (e.g., the Microsoft ecosystem) is a strong plus
* Experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations, onsite and remote, on concurrent projects spanning one or more industries
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including fluency in reading and acting on P&L statements
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an MBA
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for specific client needs
* Applicant must reside in Toronto Canada.

What Will Set You Apart
  
  

* A track record of leading client-facing delivery organizations where retention and satisfaction are the primary measures of success, not just project throughput
* Deep, credible expertise across ERP, CRM, AI, and productivity platforms, built through real implementation experience across multiple industries
* Strong executive presence - the kind that lets you walk into a C-suite conversation and leave with the client's confidence intact or restored
* A demonstrated history of building, mentoring, and scaling delivery teams that consistently exceed client expectations
* A proven ability to turn satisfied clients into active advocates, converting implementation work into long-term, referenceable partnerships

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Your account portfolio consistently outperforms industry benchmarks for client retention, with false-starts and early terminations the exception, not the norm
* Engagements across your portfolio are delivered on scope, on time, on budget, and to quality standard as a matter of course, not an aspiration
* Strategic accounts become vocal advocates for Appficiency, actively referring new business and serving as references in sales conversations
* Skill gaps across your team are identified early and closed proactively, keeping your delivery capability ahead of client demand
* Your portfolio's profitability holds steady at target levels even as the book of business grows

Title: Senior Project Manager
Description:

You will play an integral role in mentoring staff, forming long-term relationships with clients, and pursuing new work, including strategy development, positioning, proposing, and negotiating contracts.

* Experience developing various types of reports, targeting different audiences.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate with any audience clearly and accurately.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's in construction management.
* Active membership in PMI, CCMA, or similar associations.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Reporting to the Chief, University Design & Construction, the Executive Director, Capital Projects directs, plans, coordinates and administers the design and construction of all University capital projects, including renovation and alteration projects for the St. George Campus, and the Scarborough and Mississauga campuses. Responsible for project management by selecting consultants and contractors and for monitoring their compliance with specifications, schedules and budgets. Experience overseeing multiple inflight projects that are managed by others.

Proficiency in standard computer applications (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). Working knowledge of project management software platforms and planning software (e.g. MS Project, Primavera).

Excellent and proven written and oral communication skills; interpersonal and analytical skills; budget planning and management skills, initiative and out-of-the-box thinking; and ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion.

We welcome all, and we strive for an inclusive culture that allows individual growth and shared success.

 **Job Description**

The **Platform Lead** is a senior technology leader responsible for the architecture, evolution, reliability, and operational performance of Torstar’s shared digital platform capabilities. This role partners closely with the Mobile lead to translate the organization’s technology strategy into scalable, secure, and well-governed platform services that enable mobile and web product teams to deliver effectively.

The Platform Lead provides deep expertise across backend systems, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, integrations, data and analytics infrastructure, content-management capabilities, identity, subscriptions, payments, email platforms, and operational engineering practices. The role leads the platform engineering team and acts as a trusted technical partner to the Mobile lead, with responsibility for platform execution and domain-level technical decisions.

While this role has significant technical and people leadership responsibility, the Chief Product Officer retains overall accountability for organization-wide technology strategy, senior leadership engagement, and the full digital technology portfolio.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and ongoing evolution of Torstar’s shared digital platform services and infrastructure.
* Own the reliability, scalability, security, maintainability, and performance of platform capabilities that support mobile, web, data, editorial, subscription, advertising, and other digital products.
* Lead and develop platform engineering, DevOps, QA, and related technical team members as assigned.
* Partner with the Chief Product Officer on enterprise technology strategy, architecture, investment priorities, and delivery planning.
* Establish and maintain platform engineering standards for APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, security, resilience, and incident management.
* Ensure that platform roadmaps enable product teams—particularly the mobile team—to deliver customer value quickly, reliably, and safely.
* Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions, architectural guidance, and implementation plans.
* Lead the technical assessment, selection, integration, and management of platform technologies, vendors, and external delivery partners.
* Improve engineering productivity through strong developer tooling, automation, documentation, deployment practices, and operational processes.
* Monitor platform health and production-quality metrics; identify risks, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
* Support technology governance by documenting architectural decisions, managing technical debt, and maintaining a clear view of platform dependencies and risks.
* Collaborate with Product, Data, Editorial, Revenue, Security, and other stakeholders to ensure technology solutions meet organizational needs.
* Keep current with developments in cloud platforms, AI, data infrastructure, backend systems, security, and software delivery practices.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering at this level of technical scope and complexity.
* 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading technical teams or major platform initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and shared technology services.
* Strong knowledge of modern cloud computing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, security, system reliability, and software architecture.
* Experience supporting large-scale, consumer-facing digital products or high-availability digital platforms.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor engineers while driving complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Experience with platform domains such as content management, identity and access management, subscriptions, payments, data and analytics, email platforms, or enterprise integrations is strongly preferred.
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* A practical, collaborative approach to balancing platform health, technical debt, delivery needs, and long-term scalability.

Ensure the respective technologies have optimum capacity and availability to meet the existing and future needs of the business. Manage and minimize risks within the respective technologies.
  
  
**In This Role You Will**

* Define KPI’s for the teams in line with departmental goals and objectives. Consistently meet or exceed agreed KPI’s. Ensure all communications, reports and updates are accurate and consistently delivered in a timely manner.
* Ensure technologies comply with corporate security policies and procedures and all audit observations, risks and/or exceptions are identified and positively managed. Ensure all security and other operating system patches are promptly identified, reviewed, and assessed for their impact on the relevant environment and accordingly implemented on the relevant technologies.
* Responsible for providing 3rd level support for the relevant technology environment to the Incident and the Problem Management teams ensuring efficient root cause analysis is provided and avoiding reoccurrence of incidents.
* Collaborate closely with all IT teams to deliver products and services that contribute to the organization growth.
* Responsible for setting clear and consistent performance objectives, implementing performance management and development plans to ensure standards of performance and productivity are achieved and maintained enabling a high-performance culture. Manage the technical expertise within the team so that resources are appropriately and effectively allocated. Assign suitably qualified resources to projects to support the ongoing IT work programme.
* Identify and develop needed products or services by creating Business Cases, conducting RFT’s and coordinating with various stakeholders inside IT as well as other departments.
* Develop and effectively manage the team and technology budgets. Manage total cost of ownership of products and services within the respective technologies ensuring costs are identified, defined and reported, to enable businesses to make informed financial decisions, positively contribute to the process of cost control and provide financial transparency.
* Work closely with teams responsible for vendor management and vendor contract negotiations, to ensure SLA’s are monitored and managed and contracts are seen to be value for money.
* Provide technical consultancy and guidance to the team members and technical manager of other technologies, enterprise architects, and project teams. Providing technical expertise to the enterprise architecture team for defining architecture strategy and standards and design the relevant technologies accordingly.
* Identify areas of improvement in existing technologies including end of life technology replacement and evaluation of new relevant technologies within the relevant environment in accordance with industry trends. Drive projects through assigned project managers.

Qualification
  
  
**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

Title: Vice President, Core Infrastrucutre
Location: Global Village, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Description:
***Posting Type***
Hybrid
  
  
**Job Overview**
Rel aiR is the high-scale, secure, and defensible platform where legal data lives. It runs on infrastructure that has to be available, economical, and compliant in every region we serve. We hold more than 100 petabytes of customer data today, and we are building for hundreds of petabytes in the next three years, scaling potentially to an exabyte within five. This is sensitive data at scale, and managing it requires a global understanding of data management.
  
  
The load is rising from multiple directions at once. More legal work is being done with the help of AI-driven software. AI is supporting more use cases across Legal Data Intelligence. MCP (Model Context Protocol) and third-party builder programs are automating more workflows. And we are moving all new matters to Rel aiR. Together these have taken the AI results we produce from millions to hundreds of millions, and we are headed to billions.
  
  
We are hiring a Vice President of Core Infrastructure to build the foundation for that growth and to join the leadership team of Engineering at Relativity. You will own SQL platform, compute (Kubernetes), reliability and operations, and incident and problem management, and build a new capacity-forecasting function.
  
  
Your strategy will span multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data. You will stay agile when cloud storage capacity is tight, adapt to data sovereignty and local requirements around the world, and work with Security to keep the fortress secure. You will work with engineering teams to raise utilization and route work to the resources available, and you will make sure we use services that meet our economic targets, and use them well.
  
  
**Job Description And Requirements**
**This is a builder’s job.**
We are 25 years old and, in many ways, still a startup. We are growing fast, and the infrastructure we need for the next five years does not exist yet. You will not inherit a mature platform to operate. You will build the strategy, the talent, and the capacity engine while the platform carries production traffic. Our Cloud Native Transformation is re-platforming Rel aiR so that every matter, including the largest and most complex, runs on a cloud-native foundation, and it depends on what you will lead. We need your help to build it and to execute it.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliability customers can feel. Availability and recovery that match the trust customers place in us, with fewer severe incidents and faster resolution.
* Infrastructure with options. Storage and compute across multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data, with the agility to shift when cloud capacity is constrained.
* Global by design. Data placement and operations that meet data sovereignty and local requirements wherever our customers are.
* A secure fortress. Infrastructure and security decisions made together, with a close and trusted relationship between your organization and Security.
* Efficient use of capacity. Engineering teams use resources more fully, work routes to the capacity that is available, and the services we choose meet our economic targets and are used appropriately.
* Infrastructure that carries the transformation. The data and compute platform keeps pace with the Cloud Native Transformation, and structural change ships in steady increments.
* One owner from detection to fix. Incident response and problem management sit in one organization, and the same root causes stop recurring.
* A strong teammate across Engineering. You help set direction beyond your own domain and are known as a leader inside the company and across the industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Set the vision. Define what infrastructure for a leading data company looks like, and bring your organization and your peers along.
* Own reliability end to end. Observability, site services, on-call, incident response, and problem management sit with you.
* Build the storage and compute strategy. Multiple data centers, multiple storage options, and the capacity model that shows where each choice breaks as data grows toward an exabyte.
* Manage cost as part of the job. Own the economics of the services we use, and work with Finance on how storage and AI costs affect gross margin.
* Partner with Security. Keep the fortress secure through shared priorities, shared roadmaps, and clear ownership.
* Work with engineering teams. Raise utilization, route work to available resources, and adapt to cloud storage availability and to local requirements.
* Build the organization. Recruit the leaders, set the operating rules, and decide the mix of in-house and contract teams.
* Lead across Engineering. Work daily with the leaders of data pipelines, security, AI products, and the builder platform, and take a seat in decisions that reach beyond your domain.
* Use AI to run production. Apply AI to detection, root-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Stay in touch with the details. Operate comfortably at 1,000 feet and at ground level. Go deep on a root-cause analysis or a customer escalation and find the cause. Walk to a whiteboard and sketch the architecture, including where it breaks.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* A builder’s record. You have built strategy and talent in a fast-growing company, not only operated a mature platform.
* SaaS operations at scale. A record of running infrastructure and site reliability for a multi-tenant SaaS platform with demanding availability commitments and petabytes of customer data.
* Global data management. Experience placing and operating sensitive data across multiple regions and data centers, and meeting data sovereignty and local requirements.
* Infrastructure leadership. Led organizations of 100+ engineers across SRE, database platform, and container platform disciplines, including contractor teams.
* Cost and capacity economics. You have managed infrastructure cost against economic targets, and made build-versus-buy decisions on storage or compute at petabyte scale.
* Cloud-native depth. Kubernetes, SQL at scale, and a major public cloud. Hyperscale cloud provider experience is valuable.
* Incident leadership. You have reduced severe incidents and time to resolve in a large organization.
* Technical credibility. You can challenge an architecture, a capacity forecast, and an incident review on the merits.

**Valuable But Not Required**

* Regulated or FedRAMP-authorized environments.
* Experience with eDiscovery or other large document platforms.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company or one preparing for an IPO.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the infrastructure under the largest legal data footprint in the world, and build it for an exabyte.
* Join a 25-year-old company that still moves like a startup, with the mandate to shape the strategy and the team.
* Report to the CTO and sit on the Engineering leadership team, with direct access to the executive team and the board.
* Run a platform where an outage delays litigation, investigations, and regulatory deadlines for customers.
* Competitive compensation, including equity participation in a private equity-backed company at an inflection point.

**Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.**
This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.
  
  
The expected salary range for this role is between following values:
  
  
$240,000 and $360,000
  
  
The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Budget Management, Cloud Native, Cloud-Native Architecture, Cloud-Native Computing, Data Management, Data Science, Engineering Management, Innovation, Leadership, Product Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Software as a Service (SaaS), Software Development, System Designs

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.

**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

  
**Requirements**

**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

Title: Senior Program Director
Description:
**Description**

Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior Program Director to lead NATO's Operational Network Extension (ON-X), a large-scale $1B+ multi-year enterprise IT transformation and managed-services program for the NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA). The ON-X program will modernize NATO's operational network through secure multi-cloud infrastructure, network transformation, cybersecurity, and long-term managed services.

The selected leader will have overall accountability for program execution, financial performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence across a complex, multi-year contractual framework.

**This role requires more than traditional program management.** We are seeking a strategic leader who understands how to successfully execute highly complex contracts, manage an extensive network of delivery partners, navigate evolving customer priorities, and align multinational teams to achieve mission-critical outcomes.

**International Expatriate Opportunity.** This position will initially be based in the **United States with travel to Reston, VA.** The successful candidate will support pre-award activities, including travel to Reston, Virginia, and Europe, before transitioning to an international assignment.

  

Following contract award, the selected candidate is expected to **relocate to The Hague, Netherlands, on or around May 2027**, where they will lead program execution and engage directly with NATO stakeholders.

**Leidos will provide a comprehensive expatriate total compensation package** designed to support the successful candidate's international transition and assignment, including

Leidos-funded relocation and applicable expatriate benefits and allowances, subject to company policy and eligibility.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a proven program manager who has successfully led enterprise technology programs exceeding $500M and delivered complex, security-sensitive IT transformations involving resilient infrastructure, application migration, and integrated service management. This individual must combine strong technical program leadership with financial accountability, executive customer engagement, and the ability to lead ON-X as a major business enterprise.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Program Leadership:** Lead all aspects of program execution, including cost, schedule, technical performance, contractual compliance, and successful completion of tasks and deliverables.
* **Financial Management:** Maintain accountability for program P&L, revenue, profitability, cash flow, EACs, forecasting, and financial risk mitigation.
* **Technology Transformation:** Oversee enterprise IT modernization, high-resilience data center operations, application migration, systems integration, cybersecurity, and the transition to centralized service management and control.
* **Customer Engagement:** Serve as the primary interface with the NCIA Work Package Lead and senior NATO stakeholders, managing customer relationships, expectations, and critical program issues.
* **Organizational Leadership:** Build and lead a multinational program organization, including technical leadership, service delivery, program management, and subcontractor teams.
* **Risk Management:** Proactively identify and mitigate technical, financial, contractual, security, and operational risks.
* **Capture-to-Execution Transition:** Support pre-award proposal activities, validate execution plans and financial assumptions, and lead program mobilization following award.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related discipline, preferably at the Master's level, supported by relevant certifications or diplomas.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience managing complex programs in IT, cloud, communications, software development, network, infrastructure, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise technology programs with a total contract value exceeding $500M.
* Successful delivery of at least one similar project involving high-resilience data centers, application migration, capability integration, and testing under a centralized service management and control system in a secure environment.
* Proven accountability for program P&L, financial forecasting, EAC management, profitability, and cash flow.
* Experience managing large-scale firm-fixed-price (FFP) contracts and complex subcontractor relationships.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing senior government or defense customer relationships.
* Active SECRET clearance
* Valid project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 Agile Practitioner, or equivalent) and valid ITIL Foundation certification or higher.
* Willingness and ability to relocate to The Hague, Netherlands, following contract award.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience supporting NATO, NCIA, or multinational defense organizations.
* Experience supporting major contract captures and transitioning programs from proposal development to execution.

**Why Join Leidos?**

* **Lead a Mission That Matters:** Take on a highly visible leadership role supporting NATO's operational readiness and the modernization of mission-critical technology infrastructure.
* **Shape a Major International Program:** Help establish and lead a $1B+ technology transformation initiative, with the opportunity to influence strategy, program execution, customer relationships, and long-term success.
* **Expand Your Global Leadership Experience:** Work directly with NATO stakeholders and lead a diverse, multinational organization supporting a complex international mission.
* **Comprehensive Expatriate Compensation:** Benefit from a full expatriate total compensation package, including Leidos-funded relocation and applicable assignment-related benefits and allowances.
* **Drive Innovation and Transformation:** Lead a sophisticated technology program bringing together cloud engineering, resilient infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise modernization, and strategic industry partners.

Title: Lead System Administrator
Description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

You will own internal IT end to end — identity and access, SaaS services, workstations and the corporate network that every colleague relies on daily. You'll lead a team of five administrators and take charge of the subscription budget, quarterly planning and renewals. We give you real decision-making authority: only spend above the limit, headcount or key vendor changes, risk acceptance and company-wide changes go up for approval. Everything else is your call, within the boundaries set out under "Decision Rights".

**You'll take ownership of:**

This is a hands-on lead role. Roughly 30% of your time goes to people, planning and alignment, and 70% to hands-on work: complex changes, incident investigation, configuration reviews, automation. You set up routine work so that it runs without you.

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.
* Every critical system has a primary administrator and a backup who knows how to restore it.
* Each quarter, bring a plan: goals, owners, a support buffer and a list of what did not make the cut. Base it on feedback from engineers, recurring incidents and the renewal calendar. At the end of the quarter, show what was done, what was not and why. If urgent work comes up mid-quarter, say what moves and at what cost.
* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

**3. Corporate services and developer support**

* **Zero Trust access and DNS:**
  Zero Trust for internal tools (access policies, secure web gateway, device posture) and DNS for corporate domains. Policy changes roll out to a limited group first, and the on-call engineer has a rollback procedure. WAF and the product perimeter stay with DevOps.
* **Cloud, corporate side:**
  Cloud SSO integrated with the identity provider, role assignments agreed with DevOps, sandbox accounts, spend in corporate accounts. Organization structure and production belong to DevOps.
* **Corporate messaging:**
  Apps and integrations, guests and external channels, retention policies. Before a bot is installed, you know what data it reads and who owns it.
* **Collaboration suite:**
  Mail, calendar and documents: sharing rules, third-party OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, data transfer at offboarding.
* **Ticketing and knowledge base:**
  Permissions, projects and spaces, SSO sign-in. The ticketing system is the team's work queue, the knowledge base holds documentation.
* **Workstations:**
  MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.
* Together with DevOps, define clear ownership boundaries and drive shared requests to resolution: a ticket is closed when the problem is solved for the user, not when it has been handed to another team.

**4. Subscriptions and costs**

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

**5. AI and automation**

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* First-line support in chat: answers from the knowledge base with source links, request classification and ticket creation, handing unclear cases to a human.
* Preparation of access reviews and license reviews: AI reconciles exports from the identity provider, the HR system and applications and produces a list of anomalies for an administrator to verify.
* Measure the impact: compare time before and after rollout, including the time spent reviewing and correcting errors.
* Set the rules: what data may be shared with a model and where only a human makes the decision. AI does not grant privileged access or reset MFA: an administrator does that, verifying the employee's identity before any MFA reset.
* The whole team knows how to use these tools, not just you.

**About you:**

* **Leadership:**
  2+ years of directly managing system administrators or IT engineers, including a distributed team. You have hired, given difficult feedback and changed priorities mid-quarter in a way the team understood.
* **Okta, in depth:**
  SSO, SCIM, lifecycle management, MFA policies, Workflows. You have implemented it or significantly restructured it, not just created users.
* **Cloudflare, AWS, Slack, at a working level:**
  Cloudflare Zero Trust and DNS; AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, billing and Cost Explorer; Slack administration: apps, guests, Slack Connect. For each, you can walk us through a change you made yourself: how you tested it and what you did when something broke. Kubernetes, CI/CD and product networking are not required.
* **Google Workspace, Atlassian Cloud, Kandji:**
  Administration of Google Workspace (sharing, OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence: permissions, projects, Okta sign-in). Kandji or another MDM for macOS.
* **AI, advanced level:**
  You have built an LLM-based automation that your colleagues actually used. In the interview, you will show what was built, how you evaluated errors, where you kept a human in the loop and how much time it saves. "I write prompts in ChatGPT" is not what this role needs.
* **Scripting and APIs:**
  Confident in Python or similar, and able to review other people's code.
* **Access and audit:**
  You have taken access reviews through to actual revocation and answered auditors' questions.
* **Money:**
  You have managed SaaS renewals and can name the amount you saved and explain where it came from.
* **Communication:**
  Fluent English for vendors, documentation and the team.

**Can get you a few bonus points**

* Fintech or another regulated industry; PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001.
* Terraform for Okta, Cloudflare and AWS.
* Okta Identity Governance or similar, SaaS management platforms.

**The UMO Standard**

* **Dynamic Work Environment:**
  Vibrant offices and strong local teams across Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, and Lviv — with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Rest & Recovery:**
  24 days of annual leave, dedicated paid sick leave, and observance of Public Holidays to keep you at your best.
* **Recharge Week:**
  After your first year with us, enjoy two consecutive 4-day work weeks annually — a built-in reset to help you sustain peak performance for the long run.
* **Full Setup:**
  Top-of-the-line hardware and a home office stipend so you can do your best work anywhere.
* **Growth Ecosystem:**
  A dedicated learning budget and room to grow as the company grows.
* **Impact & Ownership:**
  Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.
