Title: IT Engineering Manager — Endpoint, SaaS
Industry: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description:
**A Little Bit About Talabat**
talabat is the leading online food and groceries ordering platform in MENA, operating in 9 countries
  
  
across the region. Founded in 2004 by a small group of entrepreneurs in Kuwait, talabat’s success
  
  
expanded to the rest of the GCC region, Egypt & Jordan, making it the largest and most popular food
  
  
ordering app. With over 2,000+ employees and millions of users, we deliver hundreds of thousands
  
  
of orders every day.We are part of the Delivery Hero network building the next generation of online delivery platforms across the globe. Our network is truly international with engineering teams in 13 countries and
  
  
operations in 40+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We are hiring a hands-on IT Engineering Manager to own the Enterprise Applications domain — the devices, collaboration tools, and identity/access that talabat employees rely on every day — and to lead the small engineering team behind it, coordinating across our markets.
  
  
This is a working manager role: roughly 70–80% technical execution and standard-setting, and 20–30% people and delivery leadership. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, staying close to the work while building the automation, documentation, and standards that let the function scale consistently across markets. It is a build role — you set the technical bar by doing, then make that excellence repeatable so it outlives any one person.
  
  
Your domain sits alongside other IT engineering domains, and your success depends as much on clean collaboration across those boundaries as on the depth of your own work. You will define and defend clear ownership of your systems while partnering openly with adjacent teams who depend on them. You will cultivate strong vendor relationships and drive strategic partnerships that enhance application functionality and support — a single quote is a starting point, not a decision.
  
  
Scope boundary: This role owns corporate and employee-facing IT (the digital workplace), including identity and endpoint end-to-end, which adjacent IT teams consume. It does not own product, ordering, or operational (rider/vendor-facing) systems, which sit with separate engineering functions. Where core platforms are provided centrally by Delivery Hero, this role owns the local instances and acts as talabat's engineering interface to those central teams.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Endpoint & Device Management
  
  
Own endpoint fleet strategy across macOS and Windows — MDM (Jamf, Intune, Jump Cloud), security baselines, patching, encryption, inventory, and the full device lifecycle from procurement and provisioning through to offboarding and asset recovery. Maintain endpoint posture in partnership with Security.
  
  
SaaS Administration
  
  
Own day-to-day administration of the core SaaS stack — Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and similar — including configuration, license management, integrations, cost optimization, and strategic licensing negotiations with vendors. Evaluate and onboard new business tools, retire redundant ones, and operate the local instances of centrally provided platforms. Drive Power User Community deployment and management across entities where applicable.
  
  
Identity & Access
  
  
Administer SSO, MFA, and identity providers (Okta, Entra, Google or similar), operating local instances and interfacing with the central identity platform. Own the Joiner-Mover-Leaver lifecycle — provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access, least-privilege, and periodic access reviews — automated wherever possible.
  
  
Automation & AI (a core expectation, not a future investment)
  
  
Engineer away repetitive work: if a task is done the same way more than twice, automate it. Scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and AI tooling are current expectations of this role. Use automation and AI to create team capacity without growing headcount, and lead the team's adoption of these tools.
  
  
Incident Response & Reliability
  
  
Own incident response and the on-call rotation for your domain. Act as escalation point during peak and out-of-hours periods, run proactive incident communication, and drive root-cause resolution rather than recurring workarounds. Participate in cross-domain incident coordination where issues span into adjacent IT teams. Build reliability and security in by design — every system has a clear answer to "what happens when this fails?"
  
  
Service, Compliance & Standards
  
  
Define and track IT service standards, SLAs, and operational metrics, and run ticketing/ITSM workflows that reduce friction for employees. Ensure a consistent support model across locations and time zones, adhering to agreed service levels. Champion change management practices to ensure seamless application delivery and effective transitions. Contribute to compliance and audit readiness (e.g. SOC 2 / ISO 27001 IT controls, access reviews, evidence) in partnership with Security and central teams. Standardize before scaling — build solutions that work across all markets on a shared foundation, allowing local flavor without fragmenting the stack.
  
  
Leadership, People & Vendors
  
  
Lead, coach, and raise the technical bar of a small IT engineering team, with a mandate to grow both its capability and its headcount. Set the standard hands-on, develop your engineers, and manage performance fairly and decisively — investing genuinely in growth, and making the hard call when the bar cannot be met. Provide mentorship to team members, promote knowledge sharing and professional growth. Create and maintain runbooks, training materials, and self-service resources so knowledge is never trapped in one person's head. Manage vendors, procurement, and renewals — actively challenge cost and drive strategic partnerships rather than transactional relationships.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**

* 5–7+ years in IT operations, IT engineering, or corporate IT, with hands-on depth across endpoint, SaaS, and identity — including organisations with 5,000+ users.
* Hands-on expertise with MDM (Jamf / Intune / jumpcloud), identity providers (Okta / Entra), and SaaS administration (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian).
* Demonstrated scripting and automation ability, and daily use of AI tooling in real work — with concrete examples of what you have built or adopted.
* Proven expertise in business process analysis, requirements gathering, solution design, and vendor management — including cost-effective licensing negotiation.
* A track record of leading or mentoring a small team and raising its operating standard. People-leadership appetite is required; formal management experience is welcome.
* Strong project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously with limited managerial oversight — self-directed on priorities, delivery, and standard-setting.
* A track record of defining and defending clear domain ownership while collaborating openly with adjacent teams.
* A strong customer-focus mindset toward employees — you treat how IT feels to use as the measure of success, speak in plain language, and never say no to the person without offering an alternative.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence without authority across teams and senior stakeholders.
* A documentation-first working style and comfort operating where a central platform team owns core systems and you own the local layer and the interface.
* Deep understanding of enterprise application security best practices.

Title: MANAGER, CUSTOMER TECHNOLOGY IMPLEMENTATIONS
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.  
  
At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**

GreenShield is seeking a customer-focused and experienced Manager, Customer Technology Implementations to lead the delivery of customer-facing technology implementations across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Technology Project Management Office, this role will oversee a team of technology project managers responsible for coordinating complex implementations for new and existing customers and partners. The portfolio will include implementations supporting GreenShield’s Third Party Administration business, white-labelled GS+ solutions, new customer onboarding, Single Sign-On integrations, API integrations, customer migrations, and other technology-enabled partner solutions.

The Manager will provide clear leadership and accountability across the full implementation lifecycle, from early intake, discovery, requirements definition, and planning through build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations. The role will work closely with customers and with internal Sales, Client Services, Product, Engineering, Security, Operations, and business teams to ensure commitments are well understood, delivery risks are addressed early, and customers receive a coordinated and professional implementation experience.

This is a highly visible, externally facing leadership role. The successful candidate will have significant experience working directly with customers, will communicate with confidence and credibility, and will be comfortable representing GreenShield in complex or sensitive implementation discussions. They will bring the judgment, executive presence, and delivery discipline required to balance customer expectations with technology capacity, solution constraints, contractual commitments, and organizational priorities.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Lead GreenShield’s delivery of customer-facing technology implementations, including Third Party Administration solutions, GS+ white labelling, new customer onboarding, SSO, API integrations, and other partner technology solutions.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of technology project managers, providing day-to-day people leadership, performance management, ensuring consistent standards for customer engagement, delivery planning, risk management, communication, and execution.

* Serve as the senior Technology PMO representative with customers and partners, building trusted relationships and leading key governance, status, decision, and escalation discussions.

* Provide end-to-end oversight from intake and discovery through requirements, planning, build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations.

* Develops, standardizes and continuously improves implementation playbooks, estimation models, templates and documentation standards to ensure a consistent, positive client experience across all segments and reduce reliance on ad hoc or contractor-only knowledge.

* Ensure customer commitments are supported by clear requirements, defined scope, realistic delivery plans, appropriate resourcing, and alignment between contractual obligations and technology capabilities.

* Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Product, Engineering, Security, Operations, and business teams to establish clear ownership, effective handoffs, and coordinated delivery.

* Proactively manage implementation risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes, and customer concerns, escalating decisions and initiating recovery plans when required.

* Establish and continuously improve a consistent and scalable customer implementation methodology, including intake, stage gates, governance, documentation, readiness criteria, and performance reporting.

* Maintain an integrated view of the implementation portfolio, balancing customer priorities with delivery capacity and providing leadership with clear visibility into progress, risks, resource constraints, and required decisions.

* Champion a professional, transparent, and customer-focused delivery experience that improves implementation predictability, customer confidence, and speed to value.

 **WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience and education**

* University degree or college diploma in business, technology, project management, engineering, or a related discipline.

* PMP certification or equivalent is preferred.

* 8+ years of technology project or program management experience, including complex customer implementations, with at least 3 years leading project managers or implementation professionals.

* Proven experience overseeing concurrent customer implementations and establishing effective governance, capacity planning, delivery standards, and portfolio reporting.

* Strong customer and business acumen, with the judgment to balance commercial commitments, customer expectations, technical feasibility, scope, risk, and delivery capacity.

* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead multidisciplinary teams across business and technology functions.

* Exceptional customer-facing, executive communication, negotiation, presentation, and escalation-management skills.

* Strong proficiency with project delivery and collaboration tools, including AI-powered tools that improve planning, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

* Collaborative and results-oriented leadership style, with the ability to succeed in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

**To succeed in this role**

* Significant experience leading complex, customer-facing technology implementations, ideally in health care, insurance, benefits administration, financial services, SaaS, or another regulated environment.

* Demonstrated success leading and developing project managers or implementation professionals while managing multiple concurrent priorities.

* Strong end-to-end technology delivery experience across requirements, integrations, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations.

* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers, partners, vendors, and senior stakeholders; set realistic expectations; and lead difficult conversations or escalations with confidence.

* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for customer, business, and executive audiences.

* Strong business acumen, delivery discipline, and influence across cross-functional teams, with the ability to balance customer commitments, technology capacity, risks, and organizational priorities.

**Preferred experience**

* PMP, PgMP, Agile, Prosci, ITIL, or related professional certification.

* Experience with third-party benefits administration or insurance administration technology.

* Experience delivering SaaS products or technology solutions for external customers.

* Knowledge of digital health, benefits, claims, enrollment, billing, identity, or customer portal solutions.

* Experience working with cloud platforms, integration technologies, APIs, identity platforms, and enterprise security requirements.

* Experience establishing or maturing a customer implementation methodology or implementation services function.

* Bilingualism in English and French.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

**Base Salary:** CAD $94,406.00 - 142,069.00  
**Offer positioning:** Determined using relevant experience, skills, internal equity and current market data.  
**Total rewards:** Health and dental coverage, retirement savings, paid time off and well-being support (up to $10,000 per year for mental health).  
**Posting disclosures:** This is for an existing vacancy.  
**Work model:** Hybrid

**THE CULTURE**  
We believe a career should be meaningful. Not just a means to earn a living. Our culture is one where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Because that’s what it takes to create better health for all. We dare to challenge the status quo. And we’re driven by people who have challenged theirs. We believe that your workplace should empower you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we provide a place where you can be inspired, challenged, and rewarded.  
  
Where your growth means our growth.  
Where your voice is heard and valued.  
Where your work has purpose. And purpose matters.  
  
We believe our people are critical to our overall success. Inclusivity makes us a stronger, smarter and more informed organization. Being intentionally inclusive of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences will enhance our company culture to positively impact how we support our communities. A career at GreenShield isn’t just about personal achievements, it's about making a difference together.  
  
Here’s to Better Health for All!

**A FEW MORE DETAILS**  
Proficiency in English is required for this position. As part of this role, you will be required to communicate with colleagues or customers who use English as their primary language. By requiring English proficiency for this position, we aim to ensure that our employees can excel in their roles, collaborate, and communicate effectively, and contribute to the success of our organization.

GS supports diversity, equity and inclusion in our teams and communities, and we value the unique contributions made by all. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly to every requirement, we invite you to apply. We encourage applications from all candidates and will accommodate needs under human rights legislation throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. Please let us know of any accommodation through requestforaccommodation@greenshield.ca. Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

Title: Deals, Delivering Deal Value, Manager
Description:
A career within Delivering Deal Value (DDV) will provide you with the opportunity to help clients achieve maximum value on their deal transactions by solving transformational and other complex challenges. We focus on all operational aspects of a transaction – pre- and post-close – including pre-deal and functional due diligence, enterprise-wide integrations, and complex divestitures, carve-outs and separations. Our work spans across a wide range of functional and cross-functional areas, within diverse sectors and industries. As a DDV Manager, you will join a dynamic team of problem solvers dedicated to helping clients navigate complex business challenges — from strategy through execution. You will play a key role in driving value across the full deal lifecycle, partnering with other competencies within PwC’s Deals line of business in order to serve clients in delivering measurable results in high-stakes transactions.

**The Opportunity:**

Our team assists Corporate, Private Equity and Pension Fund clients in their acquisition, integration, and divestiture activity. This team supports clients in all operational aspects of a deal, pre- and post-completion, including:

* Buy- and sell-side functional due diligence (i.e. Operations, HR, Tech, Cyber, etc.)
* Post-acquisition integration planning and execution
* Carve-out and separation planning and execution, including standalone cost analysis
* Synergy identification, planning, tracking and execution

Your responsibilities as a Manager will include, but are not limited to:

  

* Support firm leadership with the day-to-day management of multiple projects across various value creation mandates and lead junior team members to successful execution
* Support the development and execution of value creation, integration and separation strategies
* Manage project-level stakeholders across functions to ensure ongoing project alignment, effective and efficient delivery and client satisfaction
* Lead functional and cross-functional delivery teams in developing and executing plans, monitoring progress, and achieving deal objectives and value creation targets
* Provide hands-on support to delivery teams in functional due diligence analysis, integration and carve-out mandates, structural and operational improvements, etc.
* Support leaders in managing project and risk identification, and contribute to quality control for quantitative and qualitative analysis and overall deliverables
* Support business development and pursuit activities to drive sales and revenue
* Support DDV leadership with firm-building activities, i.e. talent development, performance management, etc.
* Coach and develop team members – aligned with PwC’s values – to help them grow and thrive in their roles and to evolve as professionals within the firm
* As part of the transaction process, the DDV team rapidly develops a deep understanding of the target or client business in order to identify and assess key operational issues, synergies, risks, and value-creation opportunities surrounding each transaction.

**What You’ll Bring:**

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

* A foundation of advisory experience with a desire to build trusted advisor relationships with clients, grounded in competence in value creation and integrations and separations.
* Experience providing hands-on leadership to strategic M&A projects, with knowledge of mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures — including pre-deal functional due diligence, integration planning, separation planning, standalone costing, synergy and cost savings analysis, and post-close transformation.
* Proven ability to deliver the full cycle of project management responsibilities and to manage teams through complex engagements, including managing multiple engagements simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of key functional areas such as HR, IT, Finance, Operations and Sales and Marketing.
* Demonstration of exposure across one or more industry sectors, including Financial Services, Telecom, Consumer Products, Energy, Industrials and Infrastructure.
* Ability to develop and manage strategic client relationships while consistently delivering the highest quality work across multiple concurrent client projects.
* Strong capability in developing both quantitative and qualitative analyses of complex data combined with critical thinking skills to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Experience supporting business development and pursuit activities, both internally with client pursuit teams and externally through client-facing meetings and proposal discussions.
* A drive to embrace AI to bring innovation, efficiency and differentiation to our clients along with a desire to continuously upskill for a digital world, with an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* A demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring that diverse perspectives are heard and integrated.
* The ability and willingness to travel within Canada and internationally, as required.

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. Title: Locating Operations Manager
Description:
**Company / division** Danella Line Services, Inc.

**Location** Delaware, field-based (service area: Delaware and Maryland's Eastern Shore, Cecil and Harford counties)

**Employment type** Full-time, on-site/field

**Reports to** Regional Manager, Delaware

**About the Role**
==================

At Danella, we believe in developing and retaining the best people and providing the best value services to our customers. We take pride in everything we do to maintain the nation's infrastructure by connecting people and resources.

Danella is hiring a Locating Operations Manager for our Locating Division, based in Delaware. Our locators mark underground electric, gas, fiber and telecom facilities for utility and cooperative customers across Delaware and Maryland. This position runs day-to-day locating operations so that every 811 ticket is completed safely, on time and profitably.

The Locating Operations Manager works directly with the Regional Manager, a team of locate supervisors, the field workforce, and our accounting and payroll staff. You will be responsible to manage the daily numbers: tickets completed, production per locator, overtime, timesheets, idle time, ticket deadlines and billing data. This role suits a hands-on leader who is able to hold supervisors accountable and develop teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Locating Operations Manager is responsible for meeting our customers' on-time, quality and safety requirements while controlling labor cost. Strong communication with supervisors, locators, accounting and leadership is essential.

* Lead daily locating operations for 80+ locators and a team of locate supervisors across Delaware and Maryland
* Run a daily operations meeting with supervisors to review the prior day's production, overtime, idle time and open tickets, and assign follow-up
* Set clear production expectations (tickets per locator per day and per hour) and coaching locators who fall short of safety or production
* Monitor ticket boards through the day, rebalance workloads, reassign tickets when locators call out, and route emergency tickets to the closest available locator
* Manage ticket due times and extensions to meet on-time requirements and avoid late-ticket and no-response penalties, including end-of-day board checks on a rotating evening and weekend schedule
* Make daily overtime decisions based on production data: approve overtime where it protects on-time performance, and limit it where it does not
* Review and approve locator timesheets daily, verify hours against vehicle telematics, correct discrepancies, and make sure timesheets are submitted on time
* Maintain the daily roster of who is working, off, called out, in training or on hourly assignments
* Track idle time, late starts and mileage by locator, and follow up on outliers with supervisors
* Prepare weekly and monthly billing data by customer, including ticket counts, billing codes, emergency and after-hours work, and over-footage extra charges, and reconcile ticket-system data with accounting before invoicing
* Know the terms of each customer contract (on-time targets, extra-charge rules, audit, damage and penalty terms) and bring pricing or commercial questions to company leadership
* Review customer KPI reports and penalty notices each month, check them against our own data, and prepare disputes where the data supports one
* Recruit, onboard and train locators and supervisors, including trainee rotations and refresher training
* Promote a safe work environment, including safe vehicle parking and idling practices, highway work zones and required safety sweeps
* All other duties as assigned

  

**Qualifications**
==================

What is required:

* 3+ years of experience in leading underground utility locating or damage prevention programs
* Working knowledge of 811 / One Call processes, ticket due times, extensions and marking standards; experience with Miss Utility tickets in Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred
* Experience managing to production and on-time KPIs on unit-price or production-based contracts
* Experience with a ticket management system
* Comfort working from live data: dashboards, timesheet systems and vehicle telematics with strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Willingness to learn new software, including AI-assisted reporting tools
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Ability to pass a background screening, physical and drug test
* Strong supervisory, leadership and team management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including difficult conversations about performance
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy
* Calm, steady and solutions-focused under pressure
* Highly responsible, accountable and dependable

**Availability**

Title: Broker Relationship Manager
Description:
The Broker Relationship Manager will be responsible for developing, managing and strengthening relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners to drive the promotion and sales of International Private Medical Insurance (IPMI) products offered by Dubai Insurance Company in association with Orange Care Plus.

The role requires a candidate with prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably within broker management, intermediary distribution or health insurance business development, with a strong understanding of the UAE insurance market.

The primary objective is to expand the broker network, generate business opportunities, drive product awareness and achieve IPMI business targets through effective broker engagement and relationship management.

**2. Primary Responsibilities**

1. **Broker Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners across the UAE.
* Identify, onboard and activate new brokers to promote DIC's IPMI products.
* Manage existing broker relationships to ensure consistent business engagement and revenue generation.
* Conduct regular broker visits, meetings and business reviews.

2. **Business Development & Sales**

* Drive the promotion and distribution of IPMI products through the broker network.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to expand market reach.
* Generate qualified leads, follow up on business opportunities and drive conversions.
* Achieve agreed business development, premium and revenue targets.

* Develop a strong understanding of DIC's IPMI product offerings, benefits, coverage and positioning.
* Conduct product presentations, broker training sessions and awareness meetings.
* Communicate product features, competitive advantages and market opportunities to brokers.
* Gather market intelligence and competitor insights to support product positioning.

4. **Business Coordination & Conversion**

* Coordinate with DIC's underwriting, operations and business teams to facilitate quotations, underwriting queries and policy issuance.
* Ensure timely follow-up on broker enquiries, quotations and pending proposals.
* Support brokers throughout the sales cycle, from initial enquiry to policy conversion.
* Monitor business pipelines and ensure opportunities are followed through to closure.

**3. Secondary Responsibilities**

* Prepare periodic broker performance reports, sales pipelines and business development updates.
* Monitor broker productivity, conversion ratios and business contribution.
* Identify opportunities to improve broker engagement, retention and business volumes.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve broker concerns and operational challenges.
* Ensure that all business activities adhere to applicable UAE insurance regulations and company compliance requirements.
* Participate in industry events, networking activities and insurance market engagements.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Insurance, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.

**5. Experience & Competencies**

**Essential Experience:**

* 4–7 years of experience in the UAE insurance industry.
* Prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably in Broker Relationship Management, Intermediary Sales, Distribution or Business Development.
* Experience managing and developing relationships with insurance brokers and intermediaries.
* Exposure to medical insurance or IPMI products is highly preferred.
* Good understanding of the UAE insurance market and broker distribution channels.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong broker relationship management and networking skills.
* Business development and sales conversion capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong understanding of insurance products and distribution channels.

Title: Director, Enterprise Integration Services – OneRBC: CNB Integration
Description:
**Job Description**
**What is the opportunity?**
Join RBC's US CIO Technology Strategy and Architecture team as Director, Enterprise Integration Services for the OneRBC: CNB Integration program—a transformational, multi-year initiative that will reshape how RBC operates post-acquisition. In this strategic role, you'll architect and drive the technology integration of City National Bank into RBC's operating model, designing solutions that enable seamless cross-entity operations while establishing repeatable playbooks for future M&A activities.
  
  
This is a career-defining opportunity where you'll partner with RBC and CNB enterprise leadership to synthesize complex requirements into cohesive technology strategies spanning identity & access management, cloud infrastructure, network architecture, security posture alignment, and modern workplace modernization. You'll own the validation and de-risking of integration decisions through proof-of-concept initiatives, ensuring solutions deliver tangible business outcomes while maintaining enterprise standards and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Beyond CNB, you'll build RBC's M&A integration capability—establishing integration playbooks, standards, and governance models that position RBC to confidently and efficiently integrate future acquisitions. If you're a strategic thinker with deep Microsoft and infrastructure expertise, comfort with constructive challenge, and passion for building organization-scale solutions, this role offers the scope and impact to make a lasting difference at an enterprise scale.
  
  
**What will you do?**
**Strategic Integration Design & Delivery**

* Develop end-to-end integration plans and solutions: Define and evolve technology integration for CNB across identity, cloud, network, security, and workplace domains.
* Synthesize requirements into phased roadmaps: Translate competing business/technical needs into actionable plans, balancing trade-offs (e.g., security vs. usability).
* Drive alignment with RBC standards: Partner with enterprise teams to ensure CNB solutions adhere to RBC frameworks while fostering innovation.

**Stakeholder Leadership & Alignment**

* Act as technical liaison: Bridge CNB leadership, RBC CIO, and enterprise teams to maintain alignment on priorities.
* Communicate complex decisions to executives: Present integration trade-offs and business cases in clear, non-technical terms.
* Facilitate cross-functional consensus: Lead design reviews and build trust to resolve conflicts among infrastructure, security, and operations teams.

**Solution Validation & De-Risking**

* Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives: Validate integration assumptions (e.g., identity federation, network testing) before scaling.
* Define success criteria and baselines: Establish metrics to ensure solution efficacy.
* Align with modern SDLC practices: Collaborate with development teams to integrate CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native patterns.

**M&A Integration Capability Building**

* Codify playbooks and reference architectures: Document CNB integration patterns for reuse in future acquisitions.
* Establish governance models: Create standards for technology discovery, risk mitigation, and deployment across M&A scenarios.
* Build and mentor integration talent: Develop RBC’s M&A capability by identifying and grooming future leaders.

**Operational Readiness & Governance**

* Ensure sustainable operations: Partner with support teams to define runbooks, escalation processes, and continuous improvement.
* Maintain regulatory compliance: Align solutions with financial services regulations and audit standards (e.g., cross-border requirements).
* Monitor and optimize post-deployment: Drive enhancements using user feedback, metrics, and lessons learned.

**What do you need to succeed?**
**Must have:**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* 10–12+ years in technology integration, infrastructure, or security leadership roles.
* 5+ years in architect/senior technical leadership roles, leading complex, multi-disciplinary design efforts.
* Deep Microsoft expertise: Azure, Entra ID/Azure AD, Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams), hybrid identity, and federated access.
* Broad infrastructure & security experience: Network architecture, firewall design, cloud infrastructure, IAM, zero-trust principles, and compliance frameworks.
* Financial services regulatory knowledge: Understanding of Canadian/US banking compliance and operational models.
* SDLC fluency: Modern software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization.
* Strategic communication: Ability to translate technical concepts for C-suite audiences and influence senior leadership.

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with RBC’s technology landscape, architecture frameworks, and governance models.
* Prior involvement in technology integration during mergers/acquisitions.
* Multi-tenant architecture: Experience designing solutions for complex, federated organizational structures.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in large, complex, matrix-structured environments.

**What's in it for you?**
We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Title: Project Manager - Program Management (St Louis)
Description:
**Description**

Burns & McDonnell is proud to be the market leader in providing program management services to the electric utility industry. As our clients focus on their capital investment in the energy delivery market, Burns & McDonnell brings a seasoned team to assist them across a variety of operational roles to ensure the needed grid improvements are executed on time and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a safety-first mindset, be dedicated to making their clients and teams successful, and take an entrepreneurial approach to their job. As programs are an extension of our clients day-to-day operations, roles within the program management track allow for frequent, often daily, client interaction. Engineers on the program management track leverage their technical expertise and education to make informed decisions in the execution of projects on behalf of our clients.

Project managers at Burns & McDonnell are a key part of our informal leadership structure. They will be expected to mentor junior staff and lead multi-disciplinary teams in the execution of our most complex projects. In the program management organization, project managers will be relied on to support the overall development of project management capabilities through the functional leadership of day-to-day task execution. Project managers may lead specific functional areas within a larger program or lead the entirety of a smaller program working directly with our clients to provide a premier client experience.

Generally, project managers in program management will pursue job responsibilities in the following areas:

**Project Management**

* Lead a cross-functional team to execute substation, transmission line, and telecommunication projects from inception through design and construction to closeout.
* Oversee 5-20 projects concurrently of varying sizes ($100k-$50M ) and voltages (4kV-765kV).
* Manage projects for schedule adherence identifying risks and requirements to successfully achieve a project’s in-service date.
* Navigate projects through client gate approval processes including presentations to senior and executive management as required by each client.
* Manage projects for financial adherence maintaining an accurate cost forecast reflecting committed and uncommitted costs for an estimate-at-completion.
* Coordinate craft labor resources with client approved vendors for construction, testing and other field activities.
* Provide regular status updates on projects by maintaining project data and routine reporting as well as meeting updates for clients.
* Lead project meetings with cost, schedule, real estate, environmental, construction and engineering resources to facilitate project execution.

**Portfolio Management**

* Develop a multi-year capital expenditure plan to support client’s replacement and betterment of electric transmission and distribution assets.
* Regular interface and coordination with project sponsor organizations to determine details of proposed plans and business justification.
* Ensure synergies across projects are incorporated into the portfolio of work to prevent scope from being duplicated or performed inefficiently.
* Monitor composition of client’s capital investment allocation to align with stated subsidiary investment targets for optimal rate of return.
* Engage with project sponsors to evaluate need-by date for realistic schedules and budgets.
* Assist with creation and compilation of rate filing support for federal and state filings.
* Review tabletop engineering estimates for accuracy and scope.
* Review project change requests (scope, In-service date, etc.) and reconcile with the existing and long-range portfolio of work.
* Interface with client’s accounting group to establish financial setup for projects.
* Create analyses & reports to assist the client in tracking, coordination, and execution of projects.
* Build baseline scopes, schedules, and budgets to be released to multiple client’s stakeholders.

* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting specified deliverable dates and expectations.
* Analyze scoping and project documents to determine boundaries of required construction within substation and within electric grid.
* Conduct site walkdowns and project calls with project team as necessary to establish an achievable construction sequence with attainable outages.
* Analyze needed outages against adjacent outages scheduled in the area.
* Create initial outage sequence to communicate proposed construction lifecycle to project team.
* Coordinate with drafting resources to create engineering-caliber drawings that document the evolution of a project from present conditions to final state, and all needed incremental steps.
* As part of the Burns & McDonnell team we are looking for team members that foster a culture based on our MacCulture Principles, quality, diversity, and inclusion to enhance team cohesion and camaraderie. Individuals who want to tackle new and novel challenges within the utility industry to help our clients improve the execution of capital investment work can find entrepreneurial opportunities to assist in the pursuit and expansion of our program management offerings.

* Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program required.
* Minimum of seven years of experience in engineering design, project management or a relevant role required.
* Completion of P.E., PMP, MBA or comparable advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead and manage.
* Strong planning and analytical skills.
* E.I.T. or PE license strongly preferred.
* Must demonstrate superb oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients.
* Demonstrated success in project management which includes proposal development, contract negotiations, project planning, team leadership, budgeting, schedule management, and client coordination.

Title: Engineering Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead team of software engineers within the Engineering & E-commerce function. Own the delivery, quality and production reliability of the systems within the assigned domain, such as ordering, menu serving, payments, loyalty, aggregator integration, in-store technology or customer platforms. Turn approved priorities into working, reliable software, delivered on time and at a controlled cost. This enables the company to serve customers and locations across markets and grow digital sales.

* Own the assigned domain end to end - Own the architecture, roadmap execution, quality and production reliability of the domain’s systems and APIs. The scope of the domain will be assigned in writing by the line manager.
* Deliver the approved roadmap predictably - Define scope, estimate, sequence, manage risks and dependencies, and report status and trade-offs early, in line with the department’s software development lifecycle, so that commitments to the business are met.
* Own the system design and architecture of the domain - Propose designs and architecture changes and make technical trade-offs related to performance, resilience, data consistency, security, cost and time to market. Decisions must remain within the architecture principles and engineering standards established by the Director of Engineering & E-commerce and the engineering leadership.
* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.

Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.

* Delivery discipline: Plans realistically, commits carefully and keeps commitments.
* Calm under pressure: Leads clearly during incidents and peak periods.
* Decides through alignment: Works across team boundaries through agreement rather than authority.
* Financial responsibility: Treats company money responsibly in every technical decision.
* People development: Develops software engineers and builds a culture of engineering excellence.

**Major Challenges**

* Deliver new features while maintaining production stability.
* Manage dependencies on other teams and vendors that the role does not directly control.
* Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy systems while keeping the systems operational.
* Maintain delivery quality across a team comprising employees and external developers working in different locations.
* Migrate existing systems to the department’s standard programming language, Golang, while continuing ongoing delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Cloud or architecture certification is an advantage

**Experience:**

* Five or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade, high-availability systems
* Experience with consumer digital platforms within quick-service restaurants, retail, e-commerce, marketplaces or logistics is preferred
* Experience working with external developers, contractor teams or vendor teams is an advantage

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* System design and architecture: Service architecture, API design, data modelling, distributed systems, modern system design and cloud principles
* Programming: Golang is preferred. Java, C#, Node.js or PHP are accepted. Willingness to learn Golang and migrate systems to Golang is required
* Databases and caches: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis or Aerospike
* Messaging and streaming: Kafka and RabbitMQ
* Monitoring and reliability: Logs, metrics, traces, service-level objectives, alerting and incident response
* Performance: Profiling, load testing, latency optimisation and cost optimisation
* AI for engineering: Daily use of AI tools for development and the automation of other tasks
* Engineering quality: Automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, and secure coding.

**Generic Skills:**

* Stakeholder management

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Description:

Nous ouvrons la voie et générons un impact.
  
  
Nous sommes des visionnaires.
  
  
Nous sommes WSP.

Prenez les commandes de la stratégie, de la livraison, de la gouvernance et de l’excellence opérationnelle des plateformes technologiques qui soutiennent les applications d’ingénierie de WSP à l’échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle de leadership, vous contribuerez à créer des environnements sécuritaires, évolutifs, résilients et rentables couvrant notamment l’hébergement d’applications, les plateformes infonuagiques et hébergées par des fournisseurs, l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel (VDI), la gouvernance des données, l’automatisation et les technologies d’ingénierie de nouvelle génération.
  
  
En collaborant avec les équipes Client Delivery Solutions (CDS), Infrastructure, Sécurité, Architecture, Données et IA ainsi qu’avec les équipes d’ingénierie, vous contribuerez à créer les conditions permettant à nos équipes de projets et à nos professionnels de l’ingénierie de donner le meilleur d’eux-mêmes, tout en préparant WSP aux technologies et aux méthodes de travail de demain.
  
  
**Votre impact**

* Façonner la stratégie et les opérations des plateformes d’ingénierie : Définir et gouverner la stratégie technologique des plateformes soutenant les applications d’ingénierie mondiales. Assurer la préparation opérationnelle, la disponibilité, la performance, la résilience et l’évolutivité des environnements technologiques d’ingénierie. Établir les normes de plateforme, les cadres de gouvernance technique et les procédures d’exploitation des services, tout en dirigeant la planification du cycle de vie et les initiatives de modernisation.
* Faire évoluer l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel et les environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route relatives aux environnements VDI et aux solutions informatiques à distance pour l’ingénierie. Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure afin d’optimiser la performance, l’expérience utilisateur, l’accélération graphique et les charges de travail d’ingénierie. Définir les normes relatives aux postes de travail d’ingénierie, aux postes infonuagiques et aux modèles de prestation hybrides, tout en évaluant les technologies et les nouvelles approches de déploiement.
* Gouverner la demande, la livraison et les ressources : Superviser l’admission, la priorisation et la réalisation des initiatives technologiques d’ingénierie. Gérer l’affectation des ressources, la planification de la capacité des équipes et les priorités de livraison. Collaborer avec le CDS Front Door, le PMO, l’Architecture et les parties prenantes d’affaires afin d’assurer la bonne exécution des initiatives de plateforme, tout en surveillant la performance de livraison, les risques, les dépendances et la réalisation de la valeur.
* Renforcer la gouvernance des données et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’information : Définir les pratiques de gouvernance et de gestion du cycle de vie des données provenant des applications d’ingénierie. Élaborer des stratégies de conservation, d’archivage, de récupération, de conformité et d’accessibilité à long terme. Gouverner les environnements applicatifs hébergés par des fournisseurs ainsi que ceux hébergés dans l’environnement infonuagique de WSP. Collaborer avec les équipes Gouvernance des données, Sécurité, Juridique et Conformité afin de respecter les normes de l’entreprise et soutenir les stratégies favorisant l’analytique, l’IA et la livraison numérique.
* Accélérer l’innovation et l’adoption de technologies d’avenir : Évaluer les technologies émergentes, les services infonuagiques, les plateformes d’ingénierie alimentées par l’IA et les possibilités d’automatisation. Élaborer des feuilles de route technologiques adaptées à l’évolution des modèles de prestation en ingénierie. Cerner les possibilités d’amélioration de la productivité, de l’évolutivité, de la durabilité et de l’expérience utilisateur, et diriger des preuves de concept, projets pilotes d’innovation et programmes de modernisation technologique.
* Diriger la gouvernance des plateformes et la collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure, Cybersécurité, Architecture d’entreprise et Opérations afin d’assurer l’alignement des plateformes. Définir les normes techniques, les pratiques de gestion du changement et les processus de gouvernance opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que les changements apportés aux plateformes d’ingénierie soient testés, documentés et soutenus sur le plan opérationnel, tout en assurant un leadership lors d’escalades techniques complexes et d’initiatives de plateforme à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
* Assurer la gestion financière et le leadership auprès de la haute direction : Gérer les budgets des plateformes, les prévisions, la planification des investissements et les initiatives d’optimisation. Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des recommandations d’investissement technologique. Favoriser l’optimisation des coûts liés à l’infonuagique, à l’infrastructure, à l’hébergement et aux services opérationnels, et produire des rapports destinés à la direction, des tableaux de bord, des présentations et des mises à jour de gouvernance.
* Développer l’équipe mondiale et le modèle opérationnel : Diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de spécialistes des plateformes et des technologies d’ingénierie. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des modèles évolutifs de prestation et de soutien. Diriger la planification de la main-d’œuvre, le développement des capacités, le perfectionnement des compétences et la planification de la relève. Établir des structures de gouvernance et des modèles d’engagement pour les parties prenantes d’affaires et les équipes TI interfonctionnelles, tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, d’innovation, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

**Les compétences qui vous distinguent**

* Formation et leadership des plateformes d’entreprise : Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, informatique, ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une expérience significative dans la gestion de plateformes d’entreprise, de services d’infrastructure, de technologies infonuagiques ou d’environnements d’applications d’ingénierie.
* Expertise des environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Expérience des environnements VDI, de l’informatique d’ingénierie, des plateformes d’hébergement infonuagique et de la prestation d’applications à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Une expérience des écosystèmes d’applications liés à l’ingénierie, au BIM, aux SIG/GIS, à la livraison numérique, à la simulation ou à la conception constitue un atout.
* Expertise en gouvernance des données : Solide compréhension des pratiques de gouvernance, de conservation, d’archivage et de gestion du cycle de vie des données, combinée à une connaissance des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, de cybersécurité et de gouvernance des données.
* Leadership dans la réalisation d’initiatives complexes : Expérience de la gestion de portefeuilles de livraison technique et d’initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes. Expérience avec ITIL, Agile, SAFe ou des méthodologies de livraison comparables.
* Leadership mondial et modèles opérationnels : Expérience de la direction d’équipes techniques mondiales et de la transformation de modèles opérationnels.
* Gestion financière et investissements technologiques : Solide expérience de la gestion financière et des investissements technologiques, notamment en matière de budgets, de prévisions, de dossiers d’affaires, d’investissements et d’optimisation des coûts.
* Transformation infonuagique et modernisation : Expérience avec Microsoft Azure, les architectures cloud natives, les plateformes DaaS/VDI ainsi que les initiatives de modernisation de l’infrastructure. Expérience dans la direction de transformations infonuagiques et d’initiatives de modernisation des plateformes.
* Influence auprès des parties prenantes et de la haute direction : Excellentes aptitudes en gestion des parties prenantes, en communication avec la haute direction et en présentation. Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

**Pourquoi choisir WSP?**
Pourquoi choisir WSP? Notre raison d’être est de façonner les communautés pour faire progresser l’humanité. Les ingénieurs, conseillers et scientifiques parmi les plus brillants du monde ont choisi WSP.

Description:
Job Description:

Referral Level: Level 1

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

**Job Title:** Head of Digital Experiences

**Reporting Line:** CEO

  

Collectivus Holdings is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Digital Experiences to lead the vision, strategy, performance, and the ongoing evolution of our external-facing digital platforms across our portfolio of businesses.

This leader will oversee the digital product strategy and roadmap for our Learning Management System (LMS), Sorted app, and other customer-, retailer-, and partner-facing digital experiences.

The role is responsible for ensuring our digital products deliver meaningful value to users, support business objectives, and create a connected, intuitive experience across the Collectivus ecosystem.

Working closely with business leaders, Technology, Product, Sales, and Operations, this individual will translate business needs into clear digital priorities, partner on scalable software delivery and support processes, and drive measurable results.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Digital Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and own the enterprise-wide strategy for external-facing digital products and experiences.
* Establish a cohesive digital vision across Collectivus businesses while addressing the unique needs of each brand and customer segment.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retailer adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue through digital solutions.
* Build and manage a prioritized digital roadmap aligned with business objectives, available resources, and expected returns.
* Evaluate new digital opportunities, partnerships, and capabilities that support long-term business growth.

### **Digital Product Ownership**

Provide strategic direction and product leadership for key digital platforms, including:

* **Learning Management System (LMS):** Guide platform development, user experience, educational content delivery capabilities, community engagement, and adoption.
* **Sorted App:** Own the product vision, user experience, feature prioritization, and ongoing evolution of the platform.
* **Additional Digital Experiences:** Provide oversight and strategic alignment for other external-facing websites, applications, portals, and digital tools across the organization.
* Ensure each platform has a defined product strategy, roadmap, ownership structure, and measurable performance expectations.

### **Customer & Partner Experience**

* Champion a customer-first approach to digital product development.
* Ensure digital experiences are intuitive, reliable, accessible, and aligned with customer and partner needs.
* Use customer feedback, usage analytics, and market insights to inform product enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to create more connected experiences across platforms and business units.
* Partner with commercial teams to improve digital adoption, engagement, and customer retention.

### **Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, secure, reliable solutions, with clear accountability for product priorities, engineering execution, and business acceptance.
* Work with business leaders to understand priorities, evaluate requests, and establish clear product requirements.
* Lead product prioritization and make recommendations on resource allocation and investment.
* Establish clear product milestones, acceptance criteria, launch readiness expectations, and accountability for digital initiatives in partnership with delivery teams.
* Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful product development and launches.
* Identify and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Ensure new functionality is supported by appropriate launch, training, and adoption plans.
* Ensure each product has appropriate production-readiness criteria, monitoring, service expectations, documentation, and support arrangements before launch.
* Help establish a scalable keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) operating model for digital products, including service ownership, support processes, incident escalation, and ongoing enhancements.
* Define clear decision rights and handoffs among product, engineering, project delivery, and operations teams, including ownership of requirements, technical delivery, business acceptance, and production support.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

* Establish KPIs for each digital platform, including revenue and monetization where applicable, user adoption, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Own digital product operating budgets and develop business cases for new digital investments, including anticipated benefits, costs, and ROI.
* Monitor product performance and use data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Provide regular updates to executive leadership on roadmap progress, performance, risks, and investment needs.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing platforms and recommend where to invest, improve, consolidate, or discontinue functionality.

### **Team & Vendor Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing digital product function as business needs evolve.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes across digital initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and service providers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Digital Product Management, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, digital strategy, or platform leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple customer-facing digital products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of product development, user experience, platform integrations, and digital ecosystems.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, mobile applications, LMS platforms, or retailer-facing technology strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to develop digital roadmaps and translate business objectives into actionable product priorities.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, technical resources, and external development partners.
* Strong commercial acumen, including experience evaluating product investments, business cases, and ROI.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and customer insights to improve digital performance.
* Experience operating across multiple businesses, brands, or international markets preferred.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Strategic Thinking:** Connects digital capabilities to broader business priorities and long-term growth opportunities.
* **Execution & Accountability:** Translates strategy into measurable outcomes, clear ownership, and consistent delivery.
* **Customer Focus:** Understands the needs of retailers, partners, and end users and uses those insights to guide decisions.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Evaluates digital investments based on business value, adoption, cost, and return.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Builds alignment across business and technical teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* **Pragmatic Problem-Solving:** Balances innovation with business realities, prioritizing solutions that deliver meaningful results.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

Success in this role will be evaluated through:

* Delivery against an approved, prioritized digital product roadmap.
* Increased adoption and engagement across LMS, Sorted, and other digital platforms.
* Improved customer and partner experience, measured through feedback and product performance.
* Achievement of agreed commercial and operational KPIs for each platform.
* On-time delivery of key digital initiatives within approved budgets.
* Clear product ownership, prioritization, and accountability across the organization.
* Demonstrated business value and return on digital investments.
