Title: Manager - Cybersecurity
Location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Manager of Cyber Security is responsible for leading the enterprise cyber security strategy, operations, and governance across on-premises and cloud environments. This role oversees a dedicated cyber security team responsible for protecting infrastructure (Windows/Linux servers, cloud platforms: Oracle, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes clusters, enterprise networking, and databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB). The Manager ensures compliance with industry regulations, reduces cyber risks, and implements proactive security measures to safeguard critical business systems and data.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic & Governance**

* Develop and implement the organization’s cyber security roadmap aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Establish security policies, standards, and procedures across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments.
* Collaborate with the Manager of Cloud & Infrastructure Services or Technology Infrastructure Manager to embed security into system and network architecture.
* Manage security budgets, vendor relationships, and third-party risk assessments.

* Manage vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and remediation plans.

**Team Leadership**

* Define KPIs and success metrics for cyber defence and resilience.
* Provide continuous skill development to stay ahead of evolving threats and technologies.

**People Management**

* Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development.
* Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team.
* Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor’s degree in cyber security, Information Technology, or related field (master’s preferred).
* CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, CCSP, or equivalent industry certifications.
* Cloud security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Oracle Security).
* Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) is a plus.
* Fluent in English Language
* Strong background securing Windows/Linux servers, cloud (AWS, Azure, Oracle), and enterprise networks.
* Knowledge of enterprise databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB) and their security best practices.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Work Experience
  
  

* With 8+ years of IT security experience, with at least 3+ years in a managerial role.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes security, container hardening, and cloud-native security tools.
* Proven track record in leading incident response and crisis management.

* Stakeholder engagement and communication: Ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, technical specialists, construction teams and external vendors.

* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, ITIL or other recognised project and programme management certifications.
* Experience delivering technology programmes within Financial Services, Government or other highly regulated environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing Digital Twin platforms, digital avatars or AI-enabled building management and automation solutions.

* Deliver high-impact solutions for leading organisations.
* Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
* Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
* Work alongside multidisciplinary teams on complex transformation initiatives.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing
Description:

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

Shape the future of Technology Sourcing at Scotiabank

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment — driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing, you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology categories.

This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.

**Description:**

  

**About us:**

The Faculty of Arts & Science is the heart of Canada’s leading university and one of the most comprehensive and diverse academic divisions in the world. The strength of Arts & Science derives from our combined teaching and research excellence in the humanities, sciences and social sciences across 29 departments, seven colleges and 46 interdisciplinary centres, institutes and programs.  
  
We can only realize our mission with the dedication and excellence of engaged staff and faculty. The diversity of opportunities and perspectives within the Faculty reflect the local and global landscape and the need for curiosity, innovative thinking and collaboration. At Arts & Science, we take pride in our legacyof innovation and discovery that has changed the way we think about the world.  
  
The David A. Dunlap Department of Astronomy & Astrophysics is actively engaged in a wide range of observational and theoretical research and offers Master of Science and Doctor of Philosophy degrees, as well as a wide range of graduate and undergraduate courses. Together with our sibling units, the Canadian Institute for Theoretical Astrophysics (CITA) and the Dunlap Institute for Astronomy & Astrophysics, there are close to 100 faculty members, post-doctoral fellows and graduate students here that make up a lively and diverse atmosphere in research, teaching and outreach. Our graduate students come to Toronto from around the world with a wide range of academic backgrounds.  
  
**Your opportunity:**

Reporting to the Department Manager, the IT Manager oversees the operations, networks, security, maintenance and software and hardware upgrades of computing facilities in the Department of Astronomy & Astrophysics and the Dunlap Institute. The position supports administrative, teaching and research computing services for faculty, staff, undergraduate and graduate students, researchers and research groups.
  
The incumbent maintains departmental computing systems, networks, servers and data storage, including backups, recovery procedures and network security. The IT Manager supervises IT support staff, provides technical expertise and leads IT projects, including equipment installations and system improvements. The position contributes to strategic and operational IT planning and identifies opportunities to improve IT services.
  
The incumbent also makes IT purchasing recommendations and independently costs IT projects. Through collaboration with departmental stakeholders and University IT services, the IT Manager supports reliable computing services for the department’s research, teaching and administrative activities.

* Planning and implementing expansion and enhancement of IT networks independently
* Analyzing, troubleshooting and testing highly complex systems
* Developing and implementing contingency plans for network related software/hardware failures
* Developing network access protocols including firewall protection and wireless connectivity
* Executing security measures for network devices and introducing variations as required
* Leading and planning IT projects
* Resolving problems that have been referred by other specialists
* Directing a small group in a limited area, including responsibility for scheduling and/or workflow

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or Physical Sciences, or an acceptable equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum five (5) years of experience in programming, scripting, networking, and systems administration,including Linux, Mac, and Windows environments.
* Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, maintaining, troubleshooting, upgrading, and securing operating systems, servers, and network infrastructure in a complex technical environment.
* Demonstrated experience designing, planning, analyzing, implementing, and continuously improving IT systems and services to support operational and organizational needs.
* Proven experience leading and delivering IT projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, stakeholder coordination, and performance evaluation.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating technology requirements, developing IT purchasing recommendations, preparing project cost estimates, and managing technology-related budgets and expenditures.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with stakeholders, researchers, vendors, and technical teams to provide technical leadership, establish priorities, and support a dynamic research and academic environment.
* Experience serving as a technical subject matter expert, providing guidance and recommendations on systems, infrastructure, security, and technology strategy
* Demonstrated experience assessing IT security requirements and designing, implementing, coordinating, and continuously enhancing security measures in accordance with departmental and institutional standards, policies, and best practices.
* Experience interpreting and operationalizing security policies, procedures,and University-mandated security initiatives within established timelines; leading the local response to security incidents and risk mitigation activities; and developing, implementing, and maintaining departmental security policies, procedures, guidelines, and awareness initiatives to support a secure computing environment.
* Experience collaborating with centralized IT teams and stakeholders to support infrastructure, technology, and operational IT initiatives in a large, multi-stakeholder organization.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience translating complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**To be successful in this role you will be:**

  

* Accountable

Title: Program Management Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
**Program Manager - Operations Manager – Oracle Health Cloud Infrastructure & Disaster Recovery**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated
**Operations Manager**
to lead a team responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, client disaster recovery environments, operational project delivery, and enterprise healthcare technology solutions.
  
  
This position combines
**people leadership, cloud operations, project management, and client relationship management**
. The successful candidate will oversee a team of operations associates while actively participating in the coordination, provisioning, maintenance, and support of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments, CareAware cloud solutions, and infrastructure supporting Oracle Health applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on operational leader who can manage multiple competing priorities, coordinate complex infrastructure projects, communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure the successful delivery of cloud services to healthcare clients.
  
  
**Candidates with experience supporting Cerner Millennium Electronic Health Record (EHR) environments are strongly preferred.**
Familiarity with Millennium infrastructure, healthcare application dependencies, client upgrades, and the operational requirements of mission-critical healthcare systems will be particularly valuable.
  
  
This role requires someone comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with operational execution, including cloud resource provisioning, network configuration requests, disaster recovery coordination, infrastructure troubleshooting, and healthcare application support coordination.
  
  
***This role will be based in Nashville TN - we do offer relocation assistance***
**Responsibilities**
**People Management & Team Leadership**

* Provide direct management, coaching, mentoring, and professional development for a team of approximately 8 operations associates.
* Manage day-to-day team operations, including workload distribution, project assignments, support responsibilities, and resource planning.
* Establish, maintain, and coordinate on-call rotations to ensure appropriate coverage for production environments, critical infrastructure, and client support needs.
* Monitor team capacity and priorities to ensure project commitments and operational support obligations are met.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance evaluations, development discussions, and team meetings.
* Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to project managers and operations associates.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team.
* Coordinate escalations, remove operational blockers, and ensure critical issues receive appropriate attention and resolution.

**Disaster Recovery Operations & Client Project Management**

* Lead and coordinate client disaster recovery (DR) infrastructure projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, and ongoing operational support.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders regarding disaster recovery environments, project timelines, infrastructure requirements, and operational readiness.
* Facilitate recurring weekly client meetings to review DR environment health, project progress, outstanding issues, upcoming changes, and operational priorities.
* Provide regular status reports, project updates, risk assessments, and action-item tracking for client disaster recovery environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and application teams to ensure disaster recovery environments meet established operational requirements.
* Oversee infrastructure provisioning, configuration requests, maintenance activities, and environment readiness.
* Track project milestones, dependencies, infrastructure issues, and deliverables using Jira and other project management tools.
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing and validation activities with appropriate operations teams and client stakeholders.
* Identify risks and escalate issues that could impact client recovery capabilities, service availability, or project timelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of DR environments, infrastructure configurations, client requirements, and operational procedures.
* Coordinate disaster recovery planning and operational readiness activities for environments supporting healthcare applications, including Cerner Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions, where applicable.

**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Administration & Operations**

* Utilize the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Console and associated tools to support provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure resources.
* Provision and manage OCI compute instances, including virtual machine creation, configuration, and deployment activities.
* Coordinate and implement network Access Control List (ACL) and Network Security Group (NSG) requests in accordance with established security and change management procedures.
* Support virtual cloud network (VCN) configurations, subnet assignments, and network connectivity requirements.
* Perform basic network troubleshooting within the OCI Console, including reviewing security rules, routing configurations, subnet settings, and connectivity-related issues.
* Collaborate with networking, virtualization, DevOps, and infrastructure operations teams to investigate and resolve cloud infrastructure issues.
* Assist with infrastructure upgrades, migrations, resource changes, and environment maintenance activities.
* Ensure cloud infrastructure changes are appropriately documented, tracked, and communicated to affected stakeholders.
* Support operational best practices for infrastructure reliability, security, availability, and disaster recovery readiness.

**Oracle Health & Cerner Millennium EHR Operations**

* Support the coordination and operational management of infrastructure and cloud environments associated with Oracle Health applications, including Cerner Millennium EHR and CareAware solutions.
* Work with Oracle Health application teams, infrastructure operations, networking, and client stakeholders to coordinate environment provisioning, upgrades, migrations, and operational support activities.
* Apply knowledge of Cerner Millennium environments and healthcare application dependencies to identify potential infrastructure risks and coordinate appropriate resolution.
* Assist in planning and coordinating infrastructure changes that may affect Millennium-connected applications, integrations, or supporting healthcare services.
* Collaborate with application owners and operations teams to support availability, reliability, and continuity of mission-critical healthcare systems.
* Coordinate client communications, project timelines, and operational readiness activities for infrastructure initiatives involving Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the importance of minimizing service disruptions in healthcare environments and maintaining appropriate operational controls during infrastructure changes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to investigate infrastructure-related issues affecting healthcare applications and coordinate escalations through resolution.

**Operational Project & Service Delivery Management**

* Oversee multiple concurrent operational initiatives involving cloud infrastructure, application migrations, client upgrades, disaster recovery, and service improvements.
* Assign and prioritize project work and support Jira tickets based on business needs, operational complexity, resource availability, and client commitments.
* Coordinate across product engineering, networking, virtualization, DevOps, consulting, and client-facing teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Lead infrastructure modernization and migration initiatives, including operating system upgrades and legacy server replacement.
* Work with client stakeholders to establish migration timelines, resolve dependencies, and encourage timely adoption of supported infrastructure platforms.
* Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, third-party licensing expenses, operational overhead, and infrastructure-related risks.
* Maintain project schedules, action items, risks, dependencies, and status communications.
* Support both planned project activities and unplanned operational escalations while maintaining clear priorities and accountability.
* Coordinate infrastructure and application modernization efforts within healthcare environments while considering operational dependencies and client service continuity.

**Process Improvement, Jira Management & Documentation**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Jira workflows, issue templates, project templates, and operational tracking processes.
* Create standardized project and support request templates to improve consistency, visibility, and execution efficiency.
* Establish repeatable procedures for client onboarding, cloud provisioning, infrastructure requests, disaster recovery support, and project delivery.
* Improve coordination between account managers, project managers, operations associates, and engineering teams.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative or operational tasks.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and project records.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase team productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve client service delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in IT operations, infrastructure management, cloud services, service delivery, or a related operational leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or mentoring operations professionals.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent infrastructure and operational initiatives.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts, including virtual machines, compute resources, networking, and infrastructure provisioning.
* Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or a comparable enterprise cloud platform.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, subnets, routing, ACLs, security groups, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating client-facing operational projects and communicating with diverse stakeholders.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery concepts, infrastructure availability, business continuity, and operational support processes.
* Experience using Jira or similar platforms for project tracking, support ticket management, and workload assignment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and escalation management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead client meetings and provide clear operational project updates.
* Ability to balance strategic team management responsibilities with hands-on infrastructure and operational work.
* Understanding of operational change management and service availability requirements in enterprise production environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Oracle Health and Cerner Millennium Experience**

* Experience supporting Cerner Millennium EHR environments is strongly preferred, particularly in infrastructure operations, application support coordination, upgrades, migrations, or disaster recovery.
* Familiarity with the Cerner Millennium ecosystem, including its supporting infrastructure, application dependencies, and integration with other Oracle Health solutions.
* Experience working within Oracle Health, Cerner, or comparable enterprise healthcare technology environments.
* Understanding of the operational requirements associated with supporting mission-critical EHR systems in hospital or health system environments.
* Experience coordinating infrastructure changes, maintenance activities, or application upgrades affecting Cerner Millennium environments.
* Familiarity with CareAware applications and their integration or operational dependencies within the broader Oracle Health ecosystem.
* Experience collaborating with healthcare client IT departments, application support teams, infrastructure teams, and implementation stakeholders.
* Knowledge of healthcare IT service availability, business continuity, change management, and disaster recovery considerations.

**Cloud Infrastructure And Operational Experience**

* Direct experience administering or supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute instances, virtual cloud networks, subnets, security lists, and network security groups.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery infrastructure planning, testing, failover coordination, and environment maintenance.
* Experience managing cloud appliance procurement, hardware deployment, or vendor coordination.
* Experience working with HPE infrastructure or enterprise hardware vendors.
* Knowledge of Windows Server infrastructure, operating system migrations, virtualization, and server lifecycle management.
* Experience collaborating with DevOps, network operations, virtualization operations, and application development teams.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, change management, incident management, and production support operations.
* Experience developing Jira templates, workflow improvements, infrastructure documentation, and standardized operational processes.
* Experience coordinating operational projects across geographically distributed teams and international client environments.
* Relevant cloud, infrastructure, project management, or IT service management certifications are a plus.

**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Operational Leadership:**
Ability to lead operations associates, assign work effectively, mentor team members, and maintain operational accountability.
  
  
**Cloud Infrastructure Operations:**
Working knowledge of OCI, compute provisioning, virtual networking, infrastructure operations, and basic troubleshooting.
  
  
**Disaster Recovery Management:**
Ability to coordinate client DR projects, manage environment readiness, communicate operational status, and organize recovery activities.
  
  
**Healthcare Application Awareness:**
Understanding of the operational demands of enterprise healthcare applications, particularly Cerner Millennium EHR, CareAware, and related Oracle Health solutions.
  
  
**Project Execution:**
Strong planning, prioritization, tracking, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  
  
**Client Communication:**
Confidence leading client-facing operational meetings, managing expectations, and communicating risks, issues, and project progress.
  
  
**Operational Excellence:**
Commitment to improving support processes, documentation, service reliability, and team efficiency.
  
  
**Problem Solving:**
Ability to assess infrastructure and operational challenges, coordinate appropriate resources, and drive timely resolution.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to:
  
  

* Maintain a well-organized, effective operations team with clear ownership of projects, support responsibilities, and on-call coverage.
* Successfully coordinate and deliver client disaster recovery projects while maintaining reliable ongoing support of DR environments.
* Ensure timely completion of OCI compute provisioning, network security requests, and infrastructure configuration activities.
* Build strong working relationships with clients, internal engineering teams, project managers, and external vendors.
* Effectively coordinate infrastructure and operational initiatives supporting Oracle Health applications, including Cerner Millennium and CareAware environments.
* Apply an understanding of healthcare application dependencies to proactively identify operational risks and minimize disruptions to client services.
* Improve the efficiency and consistency of Jira project management, operational workflows, and support processes.
* Proactively identify and resolve risks that could affect infrastructure availability, project delivery, or client satisfaction.
* Balance people management, infrastructure execution, and project leadership to support the continued growth and reliability of cloud-based healthcare solutions.

**Ideal Candidate**
We are looking for a
**hands-on Operations Manager who enjoys staying involved in day-to-day cloud infrastructure and service delivery operations**
.
  
  
This individual should be equally comfortable coaching team members, leading a client disaster recovery meeting, coordinating a complex infrastructure deployment, assigning Jira work, or navigating the OCI Console to provision compute resources and investigate basic networking issues.
  
  
**An especially strong candidate will bring previous experience working with Cerner Millennium EHR environments**
, providing valuable insight into the infrastructure dependencies, operational challenges, and service continuity expectations associated with supporting enterprise healthcare applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a combination of leadership, operational expertise, organizational discipline, healthcare industry awareness, and strong client communication skills. They take ownership of challenges, proactively remove obstacles, and continuously look for ways to improve how operations teams deliver services.

* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).

* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.

* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, on-time fueling, emergency response, fuel-delivery accuracy and work-order closeout.

* Protect client confidential information.

* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.

* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

* Review maintenance findings, identify deficiencies and coordinate escalation of repair needs to the appropriate repair team for client approval.

* Plan recurring generator fueling, fuel-level checks and emergency refueling based on client requirements, site access and generator operating needs.

* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.

* Enforce quality standards through maintenance checklists, fuel-delivery tickets, meter readings, photographs and complete site-level work-order records.

* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.

* Ensure preventive maintenance and fueling activities follow applicable safety, spill-prevention, environmental and fuel-handling requirements.

* Ensure technicians record generator condition, alarms, fluid levels, battery checks, fuel levels and test results during service visits.

* Obtain required client approvals for nonroutine fueling, emergency deliveries and out-of-scope maintenance before proceeding.

* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.

* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.

* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.

* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.

* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.

* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.

* Coordinate approved fuel suppliers and maintenance-material vendors, including delivery coverage and service expectations.

* Record maintenance materials, delivered fuel quantities, delivery confirmations and associated costs in designated systems.

* Use maintenance schedules, historical fuel usage and generator run time to plan service materials and fueling requirements.

* Review fuel-supply capacity, delivery lead times and critical maintenance materials with the client.

* Support client audits of maintenance records, fuel tickets, invoices and vendor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes, fueling dispatches and portable generator deployments based on geography, site priority and personnel qualifications.

* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.

* Coordinate follow-up maintenance visits, missed fuel deliveries and client communication for incomplete work.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site preventive maintenance schedules, fueling routes, dispatch priorities and travel logistics.

* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.

* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.

* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.

* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.

* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.

* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.

* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.

* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.

* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.

* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.

* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.

* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.

* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, fueling requirements and service scopes.

* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.

* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.

* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.

* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.

* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.

* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.

* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.

* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.

**Working conditions**

* Availability outside normal hours for emergency fueling, portable generator deployment, generator outages and storm response.

**Success measures**

* Every maintenance visit and fuel delivery documented with required readings, quantities and asset identification.

Our platform powers the global engagement industry, enabling companies to deliver impactful employee recognition, customer loyalty, rewards, sales, and channel incentive programs. We partner with over
**450 clients**
,
**500 vendors**
, and serve
**14 million members**
across
**185 countries**
.

Beyond engagement, every CarltonOne solution drives our eco-action mission: funding tree planting to help restore the planet. To date, we’ve funded over
**21 million trees**
and are on track to plant millions more each year. Learn more at
carltonone.com
.

**About the Opportunity:**

CarltonOne is seeking a highly motivated Director, Information Technology to lead CarltonOne's global enterprise IT function, owning IT strategy, service management, governance, and employee technology experience.

This role is responsible for delivering a best-in-class employee technology experience across the organization, ensuring employees have the tools, systems, support, and infrastructure they need to be productive and successful. The Director, IT will lead internal IT support, service delivery, endpoint management, identity and access management, collaboration tools, workplace technology initiatives, and global hardware operations across CarltonOne's international workforce.

This is a strategic leadership role. The Director, IT is accountable for the outcomes of IT service delivery rather than working the support queue, leading through managers, team leads, and managed service partners who handle Level 1 and Level 2 support. The Director serves as the senior escalation point and leader during major IT and security incidents, and focuses on strengthening process, governance, and measurement to deliver an exceptional, proactive employee experience. The successful candidate will focus on improving service levels, modernizing IT processes, strengthening security practices, and scaling internal technology operations to support a growing global organization.

**Responsibilities:**

**IT Service Management & Incident Leadership**

* Own CarltonOne's global IT operating model, including service desk structure, tiered support (L1/L2/L3), escalation paths, and the balance of in-house and managed service provider (MSP) coverage.
* Hold the service desk and support partners accountable for timely, high-quality resolution of employee requests and issues, without personally working day-to-day L1/L2 tickets.
* Define and publish SLAs, experience level agreements (XLAs), and an IT performance scorecard covering CSAT, first-contact resolution, mean time to resolve, SLA attainment, backlog age, and reopen rates, reported monthly to executive leadership.
* Run a continuous improvement program driven by ticket trend analysis, employee feedback, and experience data, with the goal of reducing ticket volume per employee year over year.
* Ensure consistent delivery of IT services across all regions and time zones.
* Act as Major Incident Manager and senior escalation point for high-impact IT outages, leading coordinated response, stakeholder communications, and service restoration.
* Partner with Information Security to support the response to security incidents, including containment of affected accounts and devices, evidence preservation, and executive communication, in line with the incident response plan.
* Implement a problem management practice that uses root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to eliminate recurring issues, with tracked corrective actions.
* Establish change, release, and configuration management processes that reduce change-related incidents and protect service stability.
* Own Jira Service Management as the IT service management platform, driving workflow design, automation, SLA tracking, and reporting.
* Partner with SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams to align IT processes such as access, change, and incident management with production operations, and provide the internal tools and access they need.
* Own the IT service management (ITSM) platform roadmap, service catalogue, and knowledge base, aligned to ITIL 4 practices.

**Employee Technology Experience**

* Develop and enhance the overall employee technology experience across the organization.
* Ensure employees have access to reliable hardware, software, collaboration tools, and support resources regardless of location.
* Partner with business leaders to understand technology needs and improve workplace productivity.
* Evaluate and implement technologies that improve employee efficiency, collaboration, and engagement.
* Champion self-service support resources, knowledge management programs, and technology adoption initiatives.
* Shift IT from reactive to proactive by using monitoring, digital employee experience (DEX) tooling, and endpoint analytics to detect and resolve issues before employees are affected.
* Measure employee technology sentiment through regular surveys and an IT Net Promoter Score, and act on the results with visible follow-through.
* Promote a shift-left approach that moves common requests to self-service and automation, freeing the team for higher-value work.
* Create seamless onboarding and offboarding experiences through standardized technology processes.

**Global Hardware & Employee Technology Management**

* Own CarltonOne's global hardware procurement, deployment, lifecycle management, and asset governance strategy.
* Develop and manage scalable processes for onboarding and offboarding employees across Canada, the United States, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Australia, and other international locations.
* Partner with global vendors, distributors, and logistics providers to ensure timely delivery, replacement, retrieval, and support of employee equipment worldwide.
* Establish global standards for laptops, peripherals, mobile devices, and collaboration technology to provide a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee hardware inventory management, asset tracking, auditing, and recovery programs across all regions.
* Manage relationships with international hardware partners and service providers to optimize cost, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Develop regional technology deployment strategies that account for customs requirements, shipping timelines, local regulations, and business needs.
* Ensure all employee devices are properly configured, secured, encrypted, and compliant with company security standards prior to deployment.
* Partner with Information Security teams to maintain endpoint management, device compliance, and security controls globally.
* Lead technology refresh programs and lifecycle planning to ensure employees have access to modern and reliable equipment.
* Establish reporting and KPIs related to deployment timelines, inventory accuracy, hardware utilization, asset recovery, and employee satisfaction.

**IT Leadership & Talent**

* Build, lead, and develop a global IT organization, including people managers, team leads, and specialists, and manage MSP and outsourced support partners.
* Establish team goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
* Foster a customer-first service culture focused on responsiveness, accountability, and problem resolution.

Title: Director, Technology, Campana Systems
Description:
**We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this** **link** **directly.**

  

**Who we are**

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

**About Campana Systems**

Campana Systems, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized software solutions for AAA and CAA auto clubs across North America. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario, Campana has built long-standing relationships with organizations that rely on its technology to manage their operations and deliver services to their members.

Our AXIS platform brings together membership management, customer relationship management, emergency roadside assistance, travel services, and business intelligence in an integrated suite of solutions. Looking ahead, we are focused on evolving our technology, strengthening our platform capabilities, and finding new ways to help our customers work more efficiently and deliver better member experiences.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director, Technology to lead the evolution of Campana Systems’ technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, and AXIS platform. In this newly created role, you will own the technology roadmap from strategy through execution, with accountability for modernization priorities, investment decisions, platform reliability, and measurable business outcomes. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, partner with the Director, Development, and establish the technical direction and capabilities needed to deliver on our product vision while supporting the customers who depend on our technology.

*This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Shape a meaningful transformation.* You will have the autonomy to challenge established approaches, make consequential technology decisions, and guide the evolution of a business-critical software platform. You will see the impact of your work in stronger platform capabilities, improved delivery, and better customer experiences.

*Build what comes next.* You will lead experienced teams while shaping the standards, capabilities, and ways of working needed for the future. From strengthening engineering practices to developing technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to build a more effective technology organization and see the results of your leadership.

*Grow your executive influence.* You will work directly with the General Manager and contribute to decisions that connect technology investments with customer needs and business growth. Backed by Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will have opportunities to expand your leadership experience and pursue broader responsibilities over time.

**As our new Director, Technology, you will**

* **Own the technology roadmap.** You will turn the product vision into a multi-year strategy with clear priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking accountability for delivery and results. You will establish architectural standards, technology governance, and engineering priorities. Partnering with the Director, Development, you will strengthen technical decision-making, CI/CD, automation, and delivery practices across Canadian and offshore teams.
* **Lead platform modernization.** You will define a phased approach to evolving AXIS, including its legacy Rocket UniVerse architecture. You will determine what to retain, integrate, replace, or modernize, guiding decisions on APIs, application architecture, CRM, data capabilities, and cloud or hybrid environments while protecting the reliability customers depend on.
* **Turn innovation into impact.** You will identify opportunities to improve CRM capabilities, business intelligence, reporting, and operational efficiency through AI, automation, and better use of data. You will evaluate feasibility and business value, establish priorities, and work with technical teams to turn promising initiatives into measurable results.
* **Strengthen security and reliability.** You will oversee infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
* **Build and grow technical capabilities.** You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and identify capability gaps. You will improve collaboration with Development and Product to ensure teams have the direction and support needed to execute the roadmap.
* **Connect technology to business priorities.** You will partner with the General Manager on technology investments, budgets, resources, and strategic decisions. You will communicate risks and trade-offs, measure progress, and contribute technical leadership to customer conversations when needed.

**You bring**

* **The senior technology leadership.** You have led technology strategy, architecture, and technical teams within an enterprise software business, with accountability for investment decisions, organizational performance, and business outcomes. You bring the judgment to set direction, establish priorities, and deliver results through technical leaders and cross-functional teams.
* **The platform modernization expertise.** You have led the evolution of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and customer dependencies. You know how to assess what to retain, replace, or integrate, develop a phased modernization roadmap, and introduce new capabilities without compromising reliability.
* **The technical depth.** You bring strong expertise in enterprise architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud or hybrid environments, along with an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. You can establish technical standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide decisions that strengthen platform performance, security, and scalability.
* **The experience driving innovation.** You have improved engineering practices and delivery performance across distributed teams, including those outside your direct reporting structure. You understand CI/CD, automation, and modern development practices, and can identify practical opportunities for AI, analytics, and business intelligence that deliver measurable value.
* **The business acumen.** You connect technology decisions to customer needs, financial priorities, and long-term business growth. You can evaluate investments, communicate complex trade-offs, and align senior leaders while staying close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions and guide execution.
* **The influence.** You develop strong technical leaders, establish accountability, and build cross-functional, cross-location collaboration. You are comfortable making difficult decisions, navigating competing priorities, and owning outcomes in an environment where you have the autonomy to shape what comes next.

**Why join?**

Axis Campana and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

**Compensation**

At Campana and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
* An interview with the General Manager to discuss your technology leadership experience, approach to platform modernization, architectural decision-making, and ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes.
* A final virtual interview with the Portfolio Manager and members of the technology leadership team to explore your approach to leading transformation, collaborating across teams, and building the capabilities needed to execute the technology roadmap.

Aquila and Campana Systems promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

Title: eTrading Engineering Lead
Description:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in Canada. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.
  
  
In Canada, HSBC Global Services (Canada) Limited (HGCA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Global Services Limited. Operating in Toronto, HGCA is part of a global service company, delivering services to support the operating entities of HSBC Group. We have different capabilities that provide tools and processes to facilitate the functions, business, and entities with their service management responsibilities.
  
  
**Ready to shape the infrastructure behind low-latency electronic trading platforms?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join Markets and Securities Services Information Technology (IT) as Regional Head of electronic Trading (eTrading) Infrastructure Engineering in Toronto, Canada. This role owns the regional infrastructure engineering capability supporting latency-sensitive and collocated electronic trading platforms. You’ll manage two infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on across data center compute, Linux, server hardware, network switching, and exchange connectivity. You’ll take end-to-end accountability for the regional infrastructure delivery pipeline aligned to agreed business priorities, alongside operational service performance and the regional risk and control agenda. Success means resilient, secure, and cost-effective services, strong control outcomes, and well-governed delivery across collocated data centers and exchange-facing infrastructure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee and develop two infrastructure engineers, setting objectives, allocating work, and building succession and capability plans
* Own the regional delivery pipeline and roadmap, translating business priorities into committed plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes while managing dependencies and trade-offs
* Manage the regional infrastructure budget, forecasts, and investment cases, controlling capital and operating expenditure and supplier and hardware lifecycle decisions
* Govern service availability, capacity, resilience, and support readiness, coordinating incident, problem, change, and recovery through to permanent remediation
* Own the regional risk and control environment, including technology risk assessment, audit and regulatory actions, security and firmware compliance, evidence quality, and timely issue closure
* Design, build, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure across collocated and enterprise data centers including Linux platforms, physical servers, network switches, cabling, out-of-band management, and low-latency connectivity
* Define and maintain regional reference architectures, engineering standards, design blueprints, build patterns, and operational procedures aligned with global strategy
* Build repeatable infrastructure delivery and validation pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing, contributing production-quality Java and Ansible code
* Stakeholder management: Partner with trading business, application engineering, architecture, cyber security, operations, risk, finance, procurement, vendors, exchanges and carriers to deliver regional outcomes.
* Regional execution: Lead data-centre builds, migrations, refreshes and exchange onboarding, coordinating suppliers and remote-hands teams and providing hands-on support during critical implementations and incidents.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial hands-on experience in infrastructure, network, or compute engineering with accountability for regional or business-critical services
* Manage a small engineering team, establishing priorities, assuring delivery, and developing technical capability
* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management
* Use strong knowledge of low-latency networking including Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing and switching, multicast, packet capture analysis, and exchange or market data connectivity
* Build continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows and automated, version-controlled infrastructure delivery aligned to a Network Development and Operations (NetDevOps) approach
* Apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to infrastructure and network engineering using repeatable lab and pre-production validation
* Write production code in Java, or bring equivalent demonstrable production coding experience in Python or a comparable language
* Build Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible including reusable roles and playbooks, automated testing, and integration into delivery pipelines
* Experience supporting electronic trading, market-data or other latency-sensitive financial services infrastructure.
* Professional network certification such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center, or equivalent depth of experience.
* Experience with Docker, Containerlab, Molecule, Jira, Confluence and CI platforms such as TeamCity.

* 2+ years of professional work experience in a leadership position. Direct management oversight required.
* Action oriented in thoughtfully evaluating how and where AI can enhance work, while applying sound judgment, critical thinking, and appropriate human oversight.
* Natural curiosity and adaptability in learning, adopting and applying emerging AI capabilities to evolve ways of working across individual responsibilities and departments.

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, work orders and subcontractor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes and repair dispatches based on technician qualifications, geography and priority.
* Monitor technician productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, parts availability and client communication for incomplete repairs.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site maintenance schedules, dispatch priorities and travel logistics across assigned territories.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective repairs within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, outages and repair delays; keep the client informed.
* Track work-order status, technician assignments, service dates and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with labor, parts, test results, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate repeat service calls, incomplete repairs and workmanship concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of used oil, filters, coolant, batteries and other service waste.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, troubleshooting, load testing and repairs at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing field preventive maintenance and generator repair programs with testing and QA documentation.
* Parts and materials management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, service scopes and warranties.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs, generator diagnostics, emergency repairs and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for generator outages, emergency repairs and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion and work-order closeout.
* Repair quote, dispatch and service response within contract requirements.
* Every service visit documented with required inspections, test results and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator uptime, reduced repeat failures and timely resolution of deficiencies.
* Low repeat-repair rates, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

  
  
  

**Job Description**

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

  
  
  

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

  
  
  

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

  
  
  

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

  
  
  

**What Fiix Business Systems Does**

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

  
  
  

**Your Responsibilities**

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

* Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
* Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
* Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
* Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
* Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
* Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.
  

  
  

Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
* Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
* Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
* Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.
  

  
  

Leadership & Team Development

* Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.
  

  
  

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
* Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
* Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
* As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
* Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
* Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
* Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
* Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.
* Build strong working relationships with enterprise transformation, IT, Finance and portfolio product leaders to deliver coordinated outcomes.
  

  
  

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
* Legal authorization to work in Canada or the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
* Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25% of the time.
* Typically requires 8 years of management experience.
  

  
  

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Proven track record of stabilizing and scaling business systems or revenue operations in a high-demand environment with a significant backlog.
* Experience owning a roadmap for Salesforce-based go-to-market and quote-to-cash systems.
* Experience leading business systems transformation, operating model design or platform modernization (e.g., CRM/quote-to-cash modernization or post-acquisition operating model design).
* Experience in a SaaS or subscription software business, including CPQ, subscription billing, renewals and revenue recognition processes.
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and CPQ, and connected tools (e.g., NetSuite, Boomi, Gainsight, Marketo, LeanData, Zendesk).
* Experience leading organizational change, restructuring teams or scaling operations.
* Experience working in a product management / PMO / engineering operating model and with agile delivery.
* You can explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.
* Familiarity with industrial software, asset management or maintenance (CMMS) markets.
* Experience defining the operating model for a SaaS business within a larger, multi-business enterprise.
* Experience working with large, multi-year enterprise transformation programs and global IT organizations.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud / revenue management, and commerce platforms.
  

  
  

### **What We Offer:**

* Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
* 401k

* Parental and Caregiver Leave
* Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.

For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $140,400 - $210,600 CAD with an annual target bonus of 10% of base salary.
