Title: Maternal Health Care Manager RN (Multiple Counties, NC)
Description:
**LOCATION:** Remote – must live in or near the following North Carolina counties: Buncombe, Haywood, Henderson, Catawba/Caldwell, Gaston, Cabarrus, Forsyth, or Alamance County. Incumbents in this position are required to maintain residency in North Carolina or within 40 miles of the NC border. Must have ability to travel as needed.

**GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB**

The Maternal Health Care Manager RN (Maternal Health CM RN) performs nursing functions for the care management of members who are in the maternal, perinatal, and/or postpartum period and who are medically fragile or have significant chronic health conditions, have a mental health, substance use, intellectual/developmental disability and/or co-occurring disorders who are identified as meeting the risk stratification levels of the complex care platform and stratification system within Medicaid or high risk/high cost definitions. This position will work collaboratively with Vaya Partners staff, behavioral health providers, perinatal/maternal care providers, primary care physicians, specialty care providers and other community partners and stakeholders to support members in their home communities. While Maternal Health CM RN will primarily be dedicated to supporting pregnant women in the Maternal Health Care Management Program, they may assist with the broader member population as capacity or organizational needs arise. The priority will remain pregnancy-related care management, with flexibility to support other clinical needs as appropriate. Work is performed under the supervision of the Senior Director of Integrated Care Management and Care Management RN Director with clinical oversight provided by the Care Management RN Supervisor, Sr. Director of Integrated Care Management, and the Medical Operations team.

Essential job functions include, but may not be limited to:

* Care Management Platform basics
* Outreach & Engagement
* Release of Information practices
* Perinatal Assessment
* Medication List and Continuity of Care process
* Care Planning in collaboration with the Care Team to include the development of specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and timebound goals
* Member education on maternal/perinatal/postpartum health
* Interdisciplinary Care Team and Ongoing Care Management
* Direction back to medical provider for medical care and treatment
* Referrals to community resources to assist member in meeting social drivers of health resource needs
* Motivational interviewing to assist members in setting health goals and action plans

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

**Clinical Assessment, Care Planning & Interdisciplinary Care Team:**

* Provide pregnancy care management support to members with mental health disorder, substance use disorder, intellectual and/or developmental disability, co-occurring disorders and/or chronic medical conditions who are in the maternal/perinatal/postpartum period.
* This position serves all eligible members, as well as their families and service providers to link them with appropriate services and resources.
* Collaborate with plan-based and provider-based tailored care managers on care plan development and care plan updates.
* Care Management can involve a wide range of scenarios which require a wide array of potential responses including micro and macro level interventions. These may include, but are not limited to: assessment, care monitoring, care planning, member and natural supports education, medication reconciliation, consultation, research, review of medical records and documentation, phone communication, attendance at treatment team meetings, and consultation.
* Focused attention and more intensive interventions are directed toward members with the highest risk and most complex needs.
* Coordinate with any existing care manager or, if no previous care manager was involved with the member, connect the individual to care management if they have further support needs.
* Timely and complete documentation regarding member-specific interactions is required.

**Collaboration and Consultation:**

* The nurse on this team may assess health literacy and provide member and family education.
* Facilitate face-to-face member visits when appropriate.
* Partner with Care Management to establish clear roles, responsibilities, and follow up expectations to ensure coordination and ensure no duplication.
* Be a consultative resource for other Vaya Partners Care Management Team Members for questions regarding maternal health.
* Collaborate with county and region-based care managers in the areas where members reside to ensure coordinated care and partner on home visits as needed.
* Participate in team meetings with peers and supervisors.
* Engage in organizational committees, workgroups, and collaborative initiatives relevant to the pregnancy population to support program development, quality improvement, and alignment with emerging clinical and community based best practices.

**Research, Member and Department Education:**

* Staff development, development of group education, and identification of best practices for specific member conditions.
* Maternal Health CM RN provides member resources through identifying and analyzing community resources, research medical and dental services available.
* May also conduct population health research, assist in prioritization of complex conditions, assist when needed in development of member Care Plan, and be a liaison for other medical teams on development of partnership for non-emergent patient care and patient education.
* Serve as a resource to Vaya Partners Care Management staff and provide trainings related to medical and MHDDSU as requested.

**Performs other related tasks as required:**

* Attend agency staff/department meetings as appropriate.
* Receive continuing education training as necessary to maintain licensure.
* Other duties as required for role.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES**

* Utilizes all aspects of the nursing process.
* Appropriately documents and communicates all required information in accordance with agency policies and procedures, accreditation, regulation, and legal requirements.
* Thorough knowledge of community-based programs and eligibility criteria pertaining to intellectual and/or developmental disability, mental health, and substance abuse programs.
* Thorough knowledge of the policies and practices of case management; skill in dealing with consumers and their families in a tactful manner.
* Proficient skill in the use of personal computers, related software applications, hardware and peripheral equipment.
* Ability to express ideas clearly/concisely.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and files.
* Represent Vaya Partners in a professional manner.
* An ability to initiate and build relationships with people in an open, friendly, and accepting manner.
* Strong attention to detail and superior organizational skills.
* Ability to communicate ideas effectively in both oral and written formats; ability to maintain the confidentiality of consumers.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with associates, consumers, their families, social workers and the general public.
* Ability to travel and work with consumers and their families in both office based and home settings. Have highly effective communication.
* Knowledge in Vaya Partners Medicaid B and C Waivers, NC Innovations Waiver, and accreditations and apply this knowledge in problem-solving and responding to questions/inquiries.
* Have a dynamic, proactive approach to assessment, screening, monitoring and coordination of care, to ensure quality supports and consistent adherence to waiver requirements.
* Understand the following areas, in addition to other required trainings:
  + BH I/DD Tailored Plan eligibility and services.
  + Whole-person health and unmet resource needs (ACEs, Trauma, cultural humility).
  + Community integration (Independent living skills; transition and diversion, supportive housing, employment, etc).
  + Components of Health Home Care Management (Health Home overview, working in a multidisciplinary care team, etc).
  + Health promotion (Common physical comorbidities, self-management, use of IT, care planning, ongoing coordination).
  + Other care management skills (Transitional care management, motivational interviewing, Person-centered needs assessment and care planning, etc),
  + Serving members with I/DD or TBI (Understanding various I/DD and TBI diagnoses, HCBS, Accessing assistive technologies, etc)
  + Serving children (child- and family-centered teams, understanding of the “System of Care” approach)
  + Serving pregnant and postpartum women with behavioral health conditions, I/DD, TBI conditions, SUD or with SUD history
  + Serving members with LTSS needs

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

Associate degree as a registered nurse required. Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or other Human Service preferred. Must have:

* Two (2) years of experience working directly with individuals with BH conditions, I/DD or Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI), or Long-tern Services and Supports
* 1 year of experience in obstetrics, maternal fetal medicine field, or public health maternal health division

**Licensure/Certification Required:**

* Must be licensed as a registered nurse in North Carolina

**Preferred Work Experience:**

* Experience in Medicaid Managed Care is preferred.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Close visual acuity to perform activities such as preparation and analysis of documents; viewing a computer terminal; and extensive reading.
* Physical activity in this position includes crouching, reaching, walking, talking, hearing and repetitive motion of hands, wrists, and fingers.
* Sedentary work with lifting requirements up to 10 pounds, sitting for extended periods of time.
* Mental concentration is required in all aspects of work.

**RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT:** The person in this position is required to reside in North Carolina or within 40 miles of the North Carolina border.

**SALARY:** Depending on qualifications & experience of candidate. This position is exempt and is not eligible for overtime compensation.

Title: Manager, Business Risk and Assurance
Description:
**Description**

  

Manager of Business Risk and Assurance

**Position Summary**
====================

The Manager of Business Risk and Assurance leads the cybersecurity GRC and vulnerability management programs at American Credit Acceptance. Working within the strategy approved by the Director of Information Security, this developing manager role translates cybersecurity risks, control performance, and regulatory expectations into practical priorities, reliable evidence, and clear leadership decisions in a financial services environment. The manager independently coordinates routine program execution, partners with business and technology leaders, and escalates major risks, material changes, and regulatory exceptions to the Director and appropriate decision owners.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**GRC leadership and governance**
=================================

* Execute the approved GRC strategy and maintain the operating model and improvement roadmap in alignment with business priorities, enterprise risk management, and the information security strategy.
* Establish clear accountability, policies, standards, decision forums, and escalation paths. Coordinate priorities and resources, and coach contributors to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.
* Maintain risk assessment, risk acceptance, control assurance, compliance, security education, and emerging-risk governance processes.

**Risk assurance and resilience**
=================================

* Lead cybersecurity risk assessments and maintain a risk register with consistent scoring, business impact, treatment plans, accountable owners, and review dates.
* Assess control design and operating effectiveness; coordinate evidence collection, testing, issue management, and remediation validation with control owners and assurance partners.
* Facilitate documented risk acceptance by authorized business owners, including compensating controls, expiration dates, and escalation. Recommend decisions without assuming unilateral risk-acceptance authority.
* Partner with incident response, business continuity, and disaster recovery owners to assess resilience risks, review exercise findings, and track corrective actions.

**Governance compliance and security education**
================================================

* Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to translate applicable obligations into control requirements and maintain traceability among obligations, policies, controls, evidence, and findings.
* Coordinate cybersecurity audit and examination readiness, deliver accurate evidence and responses, and track commitments through closure to support regulatory confidence.
* Lead security awareness and role-based education, including relevant simulations and targeted reinforcement; evaluate effectiveness and address recurring behavior-related risks.

**Security domain governance**
==============================

* Apply consistent governance across application security, cloud security, AI, third-party and supply-chain security, and data security and privacy, partnering with the respective technical and business owners.
* Integrate security risk reviews and control requirements into technology delivery and material business changes. Challenge gaps and monitor exceptions without replacing engineering or operational ownership.
* Oversee risk-based third-party security assessments, due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and issue escalation across the supplier lifecycle in partnership with procurement and relationship owners.
* Establish risk-based governance for AI adoption and emerging technologies, including use-case assessment, data protection, human oversight, approval requirements, and ongoing monitoring.

**GRC intelligence data and performance**
=========================================

* Turn threat, vulnerability, business, regulatory, and emerging-risk information into actionable risk intelligence and concise executive reporting with clear decisions and accountable next steps.
* Define and monitor meaningful risk and performance measures, including control effectiveness, remediation aging, exception exposure, assessment coverage, and education outcomes.
* Own GRC data quality, evidence integrity, reporting consistency, and workflow improvement. Connect risks, assets, controls, obligations, issues, and owners to support reliable analysis.
* Use approved automation and AI-enabled GRC capabilities to improve evidence collection, analysis, and reporting while maintaining confidentiality, validation, auditability, and human accountability.

**Vulnerability management**
============================

* Own the vulnerability management program, including coverage expectations, discovery and assessment coordination, risk prioritization, remediation targets, exception governance, and reporting.
* Prioritize exposures using business criticality, asset context, exploitability, threat intelligence, and compensating controls rather than severity scores alone.
* Assign and track remediation with accountable technology owners, escalate overdue or material exposures, and validate closure through appropriate evidence or reassessment.
* Provide assurance over remediation outcomes and program effectiveness. Technology and application owners remain responsible for implementing patches and technical fixes.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, computer science, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 1–3 years of management experience and 1–3 years of cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance experience. These experience periods may overlap.
* Working knowledge of financial services risk and compliance expectations, cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST CSF, control assessment practices, and vulnerability management.
* Ability to interpret technical findings, evaluate business risk, manage competing priorities, and communicate clear recommendations to technical teams and senior leaders.
* Experience with GRC platforms, risk reporting, evidence management, and process improvement. Financial services experience and relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or CISA are preferred.

Title: Category Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**

Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.

Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.

Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.

If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.

**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced Category Manager – Wireless Routers to lead sourcing and category strategy for our new Wireless Routers product line. You bring deep segment expertise: you know the supplier landscape (ODMs, chipset vendors, and component suppliers), you understand cost structures and BOM economics, and you have existing relationships across the wireless router / CPE ecosystem. This is a build-from-scratch mandate — you will define supplier strategy, negotiate commercial terms, and establish the cost and quality foundation for a brand-new category at Eagle Wireless. You will own the Wireless Routers sourcing category end-to-end from day one — a hands-on, single-owner mandate to start, with clear scope to grow the function (and, over time, a team) as the category scales. Day-to-day purchase order execution, expediting, and delivery scheduling are owned by our plant procurement teams; this role is focused on the strategic layer above that.

**Key Responsibilities/Skill**s

**Strategic Sourcing and Category Strategy:**

* Develop and execute the sourcing and category strategy for the Wireless Routers segment
* Identify, qualify, and select ODM and component suppliers (chipsets, RF front-end, PCB, mechanicals, packaging)
* Establish a dual/multi-sourcing strategy to mitigate supply chain risk
* Lead cost modeling and profitability analysis to assess suppliers' cost structures and identify opportunities for cost reduction and value optimization
* Conduct competitive bidding processes to ensure the selection of the best suppliers based on quality, price, delivery, and service performance

**Supplier Relationship Management:**

* Own the strategic supplier relationship: performance scorecards, quarterly business reviews, and escalation ownership for cost, quality, and capacity issues
* Represent the category in senior-level supplier business reviews and executive escalations

**Cost Management:**

* Lead commercial negotiations on pricing, BOM cost breakdowns, payment terms, and contracts
* Build and maintain cost benchmarks and should-cost models for router platforms
* Establish Cost-Down and Design-to-Cost principles for the category

**Category & Product Strategy:**

* Own category strategy across the product lifecycle — from initial sourcing and supplier selection through NPI and cost-downs — partnering with plant procurement teams on execution and delivery
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, Quality, and Program Management on RFQs and new product introductions
* Ensure supplier and category compliance with industry regulations, certifications (e.g. FCC, CE, Wi-Fi Alliance), and quality standards

**Market & Industry Insight:**

* Monitor component market trends, allocation risk, and pricing movements (e.g. Wi-Fi chipsets, memory, RF components) and translate them into sourcing action
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes affecting the wireless networking and consumer electronics sectors
* Perform market analysis to track competitor offerings and pricing strategies to maintain a competitive edge

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product Development teams to ensure sourcing strategies align with market demands and customer requirements
* Provide strategic sourcing input and guidance for new product development and portfolio management

**Sourcing Analytics & Reporting:**

* Prepare regular reports on category performance, supplier metrics, cost savings, and other key performance indicators
* Use data-driven insights to guide decision-making and continuously improve category strategy

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on strategic sourcing / procurement experience, of which at least 3 years sourcing wireless routers, CPE, or Wi-Fi networking hardware (general category-management or non-procurement backgrounds are not a fit for this role)
* Existing, direct working relationships with router / CPE ODMs and Wi-Fi chipset vendors — be prepared to name the specific ODMs and chipset vendors you have personally sourced from
* Strong command of BOM costing, cost breakdown negotiation, and should-cost analysis
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Experience with ERP/procurement systems (e.g. SAP, NetSuite)
* Willingness to travel internationally to Asia for supplier visits (approx. 20–30%)
* Fluent English

**What We Offer:**

*Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.*

*Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.*

Title: AI Adoption Program Manager
Description:
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
The Strategy and Future Department is seeking an AI Adoption Programme Manager who will be responsible for leading the day-to-day implementation of Zayed University's Agentic AI Framework, acting as the formal liaison with the UAE Government's Agentic AI Project national PMO, and coordinating AI Workstream Coordinators, AI Domain Leads and the AI Implementation Partner/Vendor across all phases of delivery, to ensure the University meets its national AI transformation targets, scales AI adoption responsibly across academic and operational functions, and delivers measurable institutional value in line with ZU's strategic objectives and the UAE AI Strategy 2031.
  
  
**The Responsibilities**
Strategic & Programme Governance
  
  

* Translate the approved AI Framework into a detailed, sequenced delivery plan and governance action plan, aligned to the timeline and reporting requirements of the UAE Government's Agentic AI Project.
* Act as ZU's dedicated point of contact and formal liaison with the National PMO, ensuring timely submission of action plans, wave reports and performance data.
* Report progress, risks and resourcing needs to the AI Strategic Committee and the Zayed University Agentic AI Taskforce, escalating matters of institutional significance.
* Consolidate budget and resourcing requirements for the AI programme, including vendor/implementation partner costs, and submit for review and approval.
* Identify risks, dependencies and operational roadblocks across the AI programme and recommend mitigation strategies to protect delivery timelines.

Operational Delivery
  
  

* Coordinate the RFP process and onboarding of the AI Implementation Partner/Vendor with the Strategy & Future and Digital Transformation Departments and manage the vendor relationship across all delivery phases.
* Coordinate with the AI and Data Technologies Workstream and IT/Digital Transformation on technology sourcing, integration architecture, data readiness and security requirements.
* Support the formalisation of AI governance: Committee Terms of Reference, decision rights, acceptable-use policy, assessment policy and risk-review/escalation processes.
* Coordinate the design and rollout of role-based AI literacy and capability-building programmes for faculty, staff and students, incorporating FAHR training requirements.
* Establish and support the AI Champions Network to cascade knowledge and sustain adoption across colleges and business units.
* Track and report programme KPIs, adoption metrics, training completion rates and use-case outcomes, feeding lessons learned into successive waves.
* Manage incident reporting and escalation for live AI use cases in line with approved national procedures.
* Prepare briefing materials, decision papers and progress reports for university leadership, the Board of Trustees and national stakeholders.
* Perform ad-hoc activities related to the AI programme, as requested by the Direct Supervisor.

Coordination & People
  
  

* Coordinate the day-to-day activities of the Vendors, AI Workstream domain leads and coordinators
* Provide guidance and direction to AI Champions ensuring alignment with programme objectives and timelines.
* Identify capability and resourcing gaps within the AI programme team and liaise with HR/Strategy & Future leadership to address them.

**The Requirements**

* Master's degree with a minimum of 10 years of experience and at least 6 years in a managerial position.
* Prior experience in higher education, government or a regulated public-sector entity is preferred.
* Certification in Programme/Project Management (e.g. PMP, MSP, PRINCE2) and/or AI-related certification is preferred.
* Written and spoken English and Arabic language is a must.

TO APPLY
  
  
In addition to completing the online application form, attach a cover letter, a current CV, and three professional references' names and contact details.
  
  
While we appreciate all applications, you will be contacted only if selected for an interview.
  
  
For any further inquiries, please contact Recruitment@zu.ac.ae

Title: Head of Project Execution, C&I Energy
Description:
**About The Role**

We are looking for an experienced Head of Project Execution to lead project execution for Yellow Door Energy's commercial and industrial (C&I) portfolio across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman and Qatar. The role will ideally based in Saudi Arabia but we may consider Dubai.

Reporting to the Group COO, you will lead engineering and project management for our core C&I project portfolio across solar PV, BESS and grid-connected energy solutions. Your accountability will run from pre-construction design through construction and commissioning to handover to Operations & Maintenance. You will make sure projects are technically robust, safely delivered, commercially disciplined and aligned with approved investment assumptions.

This is a senior leadership role that operates at both strategic and technical level. It suits someone who combines proven C&I execution leadership with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS, electrical infrastructure and grid connection. You will build and lead a high-performing regional team and set the standards, governance and ways of working that shape how YDE engineers and delivers its projects.

**What You'll Deliver & Own**

**Team and execution leadership**

* Lead and develop the regional Execution team across engineering and project management, setting clear priorities, standards and accountabilities aligned with Group and country objectives.
* Build team capability through coaching, performance management, succession planning and recruitment as the portfolio grows.
* Lead senior engagement with clients, EPC contractors, consultants, suppliers and delivery partners, resolving material technical and execution issues.
* Work closely with Development, Commercial, Technical, Procurement and PMO, Finance, Legal, O&M and QHSSE to ensure execution requirements are reflected in project decisions and commitments.
* Embed consistent project governance, reporting, lessons learned and continuous improvement across the regional portfolio.

**Engineering, grid and pre-construction assurance**

* Provide technical leadership across pre-construction and detailed engineering, including design reviews, constructability, site suitability and optimisation.
* Lead or oversee technical negotiations with clients and EPC contractors, ensuring technical requirements are properly reflected in tender packages, EPC agreements and technical appendices. Support commercial negotiations where needed.
* Oversee grid connection and Grid Code compliance across LV, MV and HV systems, including SEC, SERA and SASO requirements and other applicable standards.
* Guide major equipment specification and selection, covering PV modules, inverters, BESS, transformers, switchgear, protection, cables, tracking systems and monitoring solutions.
* Ensure energy yield and performance assessments, including P50/P90 analysis and uncertainty evaluation, are robust and correctly reflected in project assumptions.

**Project delivery, construction and handover**

* Oversee delivery against investment committee-approved scope, budget, schedule and technical assumptions, intervening early where risk or variance emerges.
* Direct contractor and supplier performance, including technical coordination, design implementation, site progress, issue resolution and change management.
* Ensure effective QA/QC across factory acceptance testing, site inspections, mechanical completion, commissioning, PAC, FAC and end-of-warranty activities.
* Ensure as-built documentation, testing records, punch-list closure and handover requirements are complete for transition to O&M.
* Promote strong QHSSE performance and visible safety leadership across all execution activities.

**What You Must Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* 10+ years' relevant experience in solar PV, renewable energy or power infrastructure, including at least 5 years in a senior management or leadership role within technical consulting, EPC, project execution, engineering or asset management.
* A track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams across development, construction, commissioning and handover.
* Substantial experience in EPC contracting and negotiation, contractor management, technical due diligence and delivery governance for complex energy projects.
* Deep technical understanding of solar PV, BESS, grid connection and LV/MV/HV electrical infrastructure, including protection and major equipment selection.
* Sound knowledge of GCC grid and regulatory requirements, including experience working with local utilities and applicable Grid Codes.
* Commercial and contractual judgement to resolve complex technical, contractual and delivery issues.
* Experience working effectively in a multinational, matrix environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

**Strong Advantage**

* Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE).
* Hands-on familiarity with PVsyst and related design or simulation tools such as SolarGIS, AutoCAD, SketchUp, PVcase or HOMER.
* Experience across C&I, hybrid and/or utility-scale renewable energy projects.
* Exposure to M&A, project acquisition or technical due diligence.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You are equally comfortable in leadership discussions and in a detailed design or grid review.
* You can challenge designs, assumptions and delivery approaches while keeping relationships constructive.
* You build teams with clear expectations and accountability, and you invest in developing people.
* You spot execution risks early and resolve them with sound technical and commercial judgement.
* You look for ways to raise standards, strengthen governance and turn lessons learned into better delivery across a growing portfolio.

**Why Join Us?**

You will lead the execution of C&I renewable energy projects across four markets, working across solar PV, BESS and increasingly complex grid-connected energy solutions.

The role offers real influence over how YDE's projects are engineered and delivered. You will build the regional team, set delivery standards and work closely with YDE's regional leadership and Development, Commercial, Technical, Finance, Legal and Operations teams.

**About Yellow Door Energy**

Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions.

Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui & Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation.

**Apply Now!**

If you are an experienced renewable energy execution leader with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS and grid-connected systems, and a track record of building teams that deliver safe, high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you.

**Let's lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.**

Title: Senior Program Manager
Description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services, delivering end-to-end solutions and service to clients across its global organization.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the strategic direction, integrated planning and end-to-end delivery performance of AXI within the Investor Relations Value Stream. In addition to the official Senior Program Manager title, the role fulfils the Value Stream Delivery Lead responsibilities for Investor Relations, ensuring that agreed outcomes and priorities are translated into a coherent roadmap, single governed backlog and measurable delivery plan.
  
  
As a member of the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, the role partners with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to connect strategy with execution. The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.
  
  
As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The role shapes delivery strategy, challenges constructively, resolves complex cross-functional constraints and represents the Value Stream in portfolio and executive forums. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.
* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.
* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.
* Drive consistent delivery practices, delivery metrics and continuous improvement while allowing teams to apply fit-for-purpose Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.
* Coordinate cross-Value Stream demand and dependencies, negotiate sequencing with shared services and escalate priority decisions where demand exceeds available capacity.
* Manage Value Stream capacity, resource demand and allocation, ensuring commitments are realistic and delivery constraints are visible early.
* Lead quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, execution reviews and delivery governance across strategic change, client work, business requests, platform change and KTLO activity.
* Maintain one visible and prioritized backlog linking Value Stream outcomes and objectives to executable epics, stories and delivery commitments, with clear ownership and no orphaned work.
* Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**
Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.
* Ensure program commitments are realistic and supported by sufficient capacity, funding, technical readiness and business ownership.

The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Pay: $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On-site parking
* RRSP match
* Vision care

Application question(s):

* How many years of work experience do you have with IT Strategy?
* Have you built or significantly developed an IT, business technology, technology governance, or technology enablement function or process from the ground up?
* Do you have hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO, permissions, branch protection or repository governance?
* Do you have hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 environments, including identity, MFA, endpoint management, and security?
* Do you have hands-on experience administering or supporting platforms such as Supabase, PostgreSQL, Netlify, Vercel, or similar technologies?

Experience:

* IT: 7 years (required)
* DevOps: 3 years (required)
* Microsoft Platform: 3 years (required)

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.
  
  
Compensation Range: CA$95K - CA$120K

Title: Market Operations Manager

Title: Senior Manager, Technical Software Program Manager
Contact Center Manager
Description:
Trust is everything for financial institutions, but it gets harder to earn as customer expectations rise and fraud keeps evolving. At Casap, we’re on a mission to deliver outcomes that were once out of reach, building a future where fraud is rare and trust is a given.
  
  
We started with disputes, some of the highest-stakes work financial institutions can’t afford to get wrong, and have expanded the same approach across fraud, collections, claims and more. Today, more than 100 banks, credit unions, fintechs and processors trust our AI agents to make decisions, take actions, move money and file chargebacks, from first signal to final outcome.

As Managed Services expands, our BPO engagement is the compliant, reliable entry point for every fintech and credit union client we support. You'll lead our outsourced contact center and back-office investigation teams, manage policies and procedures, optimize IVR routing and call scripts, and turn vendor partnerships into clear results for our clients.

* Drive Enablement and Documentation: Build the runbooks, escalation paths, and training materials that make the vendor self-sufficient and prevent repeat issues. Support the implementation team in standing up phone intake for new Managed Services clients.

**What You’ve Done**

* 4-7 years in contact center operations, vendor management, technical account management, or customer success, ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company serving financial institutions.
* Experience managing outsourced or in-house contact center operations at scale, ideally in a regulated industry, with hands-on IVR, WFM, and vendor SLA management.
* Experience in payments, disputes, chargebacks, or Reg E/Z compliance workflows, and familiarity with compliance requirements for phone-based financial services intake.
* A track record of turning vendor relationships into measurable, accountable performance.
* Ability to investigate issues independently: reviewing call data and logs, querying data, and identifying root cause before escalating.
* Strong relationship management skills, with the presence to build credibility with vendor leadership and with operational and executive stakeholders at clients.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: able to make a complex operational or dispute issue clear to both frontline teams and leadership, and to work closely with QA, Product, and vendor partners.
* Structured problem-solver with great composure when an issue is live and the stakes are high, comfortable building process while doing the work in an early-stage environment.

Title: Carrier Certification Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Carrier Certification Manager will own Eagle's end-to-end carrier certification program across the US and Canada. This includes managing active certification projects, building and maintaining carrier relationships, and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales to ensure Eagle's modules achieve and maintain certification across all major networks. This role is essential to Eagle's product commercialization timeline and go-to-market readiness.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Manage active carrier certification programs across AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US), and Telus, Rogers, Bell (Canada), ensuring on-time completion.
* Serve as Eagle's primary point of contact with carrier certification teams and labs; build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier ecosystem managers.
* Coordinate pre-certification activities: lab selection, test plan development, sample preparation, and firmware readiness in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
* Own the certification project tracker and communicate progress, risks, and timelines to product management and executive leadership.
* Manage certification costs, budgets, and vendor relationships (third-party test labs, certification bodies).
* Oversee PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC, and ISED submissions that feed into carrier certification eligibility.
* Monitor carrier certification policy changes, new requirements, and network evolution (e.g., 5G Standalone, Network Slicing) and proactively update Eagle's certification strategy.
* Support the sales team by clearly communicating certification status and timelines for customer RFQs and design-in decisions.
* Develop and maintain certification documentation, including test reports and compliance records.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in carrier certification, regulatory compliance, or technical program management within the wireless, module, or device ecosystem.
* Direct experience managing AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile certification processes; Canadian carrier experience is a plus.
* Understanding of PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC certification frameworks and their interplay with carrier certification.
* Strong project management skills; ability to run multiple certification programs in parallel.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills with engineering, product, and sales stakeholders.
* Experience with cellular module certification specifically (as opposed to device/handset only).
* Familiarity with 5G NR certification requirements and how they differ from LTE.
* Knowledge of ISED (Canada), FirstNet, and MVNO certification requirements.
* Experience working with third-party test labs.
* Flexible to attend occasional early-morning or evening calls to coordinate with teams in Asia (UTC+8).
* Willing to travel occasionally to carrier or third-party laboratories to provide on-site support as needed.

**What We Offer**
**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

Title: Project Engineering Manager, Staff

Description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own and maintain the integrated schedule and critical path across multiple Memory Interface IP development and release workstreams, from project kickoff and architecture through design closure, verification, customer delivery, and production readiness. Model dependency chains deeply enough to quantify the impact of slips and pull-ins, distinguish paths with float from those without it, and update the plan weekly using current engineering data.
* Drive the weekly project cadence by synthesizing inputs from architecture, RTL, design verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, packaging, software, infrastructure, product engineering, and post-silicon teams into a single view of program health, emerging concerns, and required actions.
* Track verification convergence and engineering maturity as leading indicators. Monitor feature readiness, RTL closure, bug discovery and closure trends, regression health, coverage, design maturity, and block-level readiness. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive a recovery plan before downstream milestones or customer commitments are affected.
* Analyze schedule scenarios and coordinate recovery plans. Work with engineering leads to understand technical constraints, resource limitations, and available float; quantify the impact of changes; develop practical options; and track agreed recovery actions to closure.
* Manage external partner and customer dependencies by owning delivery calendars, tracking execution plans and acceptance criteria, aligning technical dependencies, and supporting schedule negotiations with a clear understanding of downstream technical, commercial, and resource impacts.
* Lead cross-functional risk, issue, and decision management. Convert technical uncertainty into clear options, owners, dates, and decision points. Ensure risks, assumptions, and trade-offs are visible early and resolved at the appropriate level.
* Provide concise project insight to executives and customers. Distill complex engineering information into evidence-based updates that distinguish signal from noise, quantify schedule and delivery impact, and clearly identify the actions or decisions needed.

A Day In The Life
  
  
You start the morning reviewing verification-convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug-closure velocity has slowed. You bring the DV lead and RTL owner together for a focused sync, clarify the cause, and align on a recovery plan before the weekly project review.
  
  
In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects an internal delivery shift, quantify the downstream impact on release timing and customer commitments, and identify the decisions needed to protect the plan. Later, you follow-up with R&D on the strategy to take to resolve the issue, then finish the day preparing a concise executive summary and following up on owners and due dates from the project review.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Applied Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor, silicon IP, SoC, ASIC, or complex hardware development.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex semiconductor or silicon IP programs across multiple engineering disciplines and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong working knowledge of semiconductor development lifecycles and the relationships among architecture, RTL, verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, software, infrastructure, and productization.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with meaningful dependency and critical-path modeling, including float analysis, milestone confidence, and the downstream effects of schedule changes.
* Experience using engineering evidence such as feature readiness, bug trends, regression results, coverage, design closure, and delivery health to assess schedule risk and drive corrective action.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technical and program information, develop practical options, and recommend a course of action.
* Strong communication and influence skills, including the ability to gain cooperation across engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners and to present crisp status and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience with project and program management tools and data-driven reporting. Familiarity with Jira, schedule-management tools, dashboards, and engineering lifecycle metrics is preferred.
* Knowledge of quality-management processes and the ability to navigate Linux environments are considered assets.

Who You Are
  
  
This is not a status-reporting role. You will connect a broad set of engineering workstreams into a coherent, dependency-driven plan, identify the real critical path week to week, and drive the cross-functional actions and decisions that keep complex Memory Interface IP projects on track. The work spans concurrent development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, customers, external partners, and development infrastructure.
  
  
Working with general direction, you will apply strong semiconductor-development knowledge and program-management judgment to analyze issues, recommend practical solutions, and gain cooperation across teams. Success requires attention to engineering detail, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to turn complex technical inputs into clear priorities, ownership, and delivery commitments.
  
  
The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
Our engineering teams develop advanced Memory Interface IP that enables customers to build high-performance, differentiated SoCs. We work at the intersection of architecture, analog and mixed-signal design, RTL, verification, physical design, software, infrastructure, and customer deployment. The programs are technically complex, globally distributed, and tightly connected to customer and business commitments.
  
  
We value people who combine advanced technical judgment with clear communication, disciplined execution, and the willingness to work through details without losing sight of the broader outcome. In this role, you will help shape how complex semiconductor programs are planned and delivered, strengthen execution practices across teams, and work alongside talented engineers solving consequential problems at scale.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits

Title: Director, Business Technology & Transformation
Description:
North America Construction (1993) Ltd. – NAC Constructors Ltd. (NAC) is well known for our expertise in water and wastewater construction across Canada. Our self-performing team of almost 500 skilled professionals and experts in trades and engineering, comprehensively handles projects, from conceptualization to delivery. At NAC, our priority is to maintain the highest level of quality and safety. The depth of our resources is evident in the variety of projects we construct; from water filtration to wastewater treatment; dams to ethanol; we build it all….and more!

Bring your construction industry knowledge and technology leadership experience to NAC, where you’ll have the opportunity to shape our technology strategy, modernize business systems, and drive meaningful business transformation.

North America Construction (NAC) is looking for a business-minded technology leader who understands the demands of a construction or project-based environment and can translate technology into practical business improvements.

Reporting to the VP, Corporate Services, you will lead NAC’s technology strategy, manage a small internal technology team, and oversee external providers. Working closely with executive leadership and teams across finance, operations, estimating, HR, equipment, and projects, you will improve business systems, decision-making, productivity, and the employee experience.

### **Position Responsibilities:**

**Technology Strategy & Governance**

* Maintain a technology and transformation roadmap aligned with corporate priorities and business objectives.
* Establish technology governance, standards, policies and decision-making processes.
* Manage budgets and investment plans, assess emerging technologies, and develop and present business cases to executive leadership.

**Enterprise Applications**

* Provide strategic direction for NAC’s enterprise applications, including ERP platforms, Jonas Construction Software, Procore, Primavera P6, Concur, HR systems, equipment and fleet systems, and future applications.
* Lead or oversee enterprise system implementations, integrations, modernization and enhancements, including requirements definition, vendor management, implementation planning, change management and user adoption. **Data & Analytics**

* Post-secondary degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.

* Demonstrated experience leading technology functions, internal teams, external service providers and enterprise-wide initiatives.

* Proven experience developing and executing enterprise technology strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks and investment plans aligned with business objectives.

Demonstrated ability to establish enterprise reporting frameworks, executive dashboards, consistent KPIs and data governance practices that support operational, financial and strategic decision-making.

Title: Manager, Educational Technology
Description:
Reporting to the Director, Academic Quality and Teaching Innovation, the Manager, Educational Technology provides leadership and oversight vis-à-vis the SLATE (Sheridan's Teaching and Learning Environment) environment as well as broader educational technology strategy.

The incumbent is accountable for all operational aspects of SLATE, which operates for all Sheridan users on a continuous 24x7x365 basis. In this capacity the incumbent provides leadership for the administration, design, development, training, and support functions associated with SLATE as well as other integrated learning technologies, e-learning and digital innovation. This includes any internal integrations to Sheridan's infrastructure including but not limited to student information systems (SIS), HR systems, authentication services and other leveraged systems.

This position collaborates pan-institutionally to engage a wide range of key partners at Sheridan, i.e. Academic Division, IT, OTR, as it relates to planning, strategy, and operationalization of educational technologies, including but not limited to SLATE. The position engages and contributes to provincial and sector educational technology bodies. Further, the role is a key interface with educational technology vendors to ensure the provisioned tools are meeting the broader educational and pedagogical needs of the Sheridan teaching and learning community.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Managing system administration for SLATE and associated learning technologies, leading teams to improve the experience of faculty, students, and employees.
* Plans and assesses upgrades, patches, and pilots of new features; oversees the e-learning design and digital innovation teams; and advises the Director on the development and review of programs and services.
* Evaluating emerging technologies and, with the Director, builds business cases for adopting them, while managing the life cycle of learning technologies from onboarding to retirement.
* Managing major cross-College projects, supports budget and strategic planning, maintains policies, documentation, and usage statistics, and is accountable for timely, accurate communications.
* Managing vendor, sector, and internal partnerships through negotiating contracts, master agreements, SLAs, and End User License Agreements (EULA)s for all contracted services, including cloud-based services, and administers breach procedures such as responses to service disruptions.
* Maintaining relationships with account managers and other vendor representatives, stays apprised of product and service roadmaps, and leads vendor crisis management when service is disrupted or degraded.
* Providing leadership, strategic direction, and supervision to SLATE staff and other digital learning teams, ensuring adequate coverage, prompt response to user support requests, and proper escalation of issues to internal resources or vendors, with all issues documented and tracked to resolution.
* Hiring, supervising, coaching, and managing staff performance in compliance with the Collective Agreement, keeps certifications and training current, and recommends professional development aligned with Sheridan’s strategic vision, while fostering a safe, respectful, and inclusive work environment.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATR DSP Strategy, Planning and Expansion
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Customers want what they need in minutes, not days. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to shape how our fastest delivery services, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, grow and run for customers, delivery associates, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Amazon.  
  
As Senior Program Manager, you will own and lead the strategic programmes that set how our Speed last mile network runs across the region. At the core is flexible capacity: designing models that let DSP capacity move up and down with demand, setting how they fit into annual and weekly planning, and getting Operations, Finance, People teams and DSP partners behind them. Your portfolio may also cover partner commercials, compliance and training, and it will change as priorities change.  
  
Many problems won't arrive well defined. You will frame them, find the ones worth solving, align senior stakeholders on a path forward and build mechanisms that make the answers scale across countries. You will also help shape the team's wider strategy and roadmap.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Set the strategy: own the multi-year capacity and growth plan for Quick Commerce and Speed, and the region's input to annual planning.
* Plan capacity: within the regional plan, build short, mid and long range plans that match DSP and delivery associate supply to demand by hour, day and season.
* Build flexible capacity: design, launch and scale flexible models alongside the fixed DSP network, with the operating, commercial and compliance framework to run them.
* Grow the channel: launch new cities, stores and countries with capacity ready before go-live.
* Improve efficiency: raise utilisation and lower cost per delivery without moving cost onto DSPs or associates.
* Build partner economics: shape DSP commercial models with Finance that work at every volume level, and lead the trade-off decisions.
* Look after delivery associates: design fair, safe, compliant schedules and lead the regional response to labour rule changes.
* Align and lead change: bring Operations, Finance, People, Legal, Tech and DSPs behind one plan, and run readiness and approvals.
* Build mechanisms: set planning tool requirements with Tech, and the metrics, guardrails and reviews that run the channel, using automation and AI.
* Lead and write: influence senior leaders, mentor PMs and analysts, and write documents that drive decisions.

  
A day in the life  
You start with yesterday's Quick Commerce and Speed performance: where capacity matched demand, where routes ran short or associates sat idle, and what it cost. Mid-morning, you join the weekly planning review to agree where flexible capacity steps in next week. You then meet a DSP owner to test a new flexible model against their margin and their associates' hours. After lunch, you work with Finance and Legal on the case for scaling it to a second country. You end the day writing for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.  
  
About the team  
This is a new role reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATr DSP. Quick Commerce and Speed, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, are delivered by DSPs, and flexible capacity is a lead theme in the region's 2027 plan. You will own Speed capacity and flexible capacity programmes across the region, planning inside the regional capacity plan and working with the Network Optimisation team, who own rate cards. You will mentor PMs and analysts and write planning papers reviewed at Director and VP level.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
