Title: Senior Manager, Fulfillment
Description:
**Who We Are**

Chomps is America's fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

**Traits of a Chompian**

If you've been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You're a team player who's self-motivated and action-oriented. You're committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You're a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you'll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You're hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

**What You Will Do**

The Senior Manager, Fulfillment is responsible for managing day-to-day fulfillment execution and the customer service function to ensure Chomps' fulfillment network operates with accuracy, accountability, cost discipline, and scalability. This role translates established fulfillment priorities into clear operating routines and partner expectations across multiple distribution locations and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate brings strong fulfillment and 3PL management experience, understands order execution and customer service operations, and can turn complex operational priorities into practical processes, measurable results, and clear cross-functional communication.

**Role Expectations:** This role is expected to independently manage recurring fulfillment and customer service cadences, 3PL partner follow-up, KPI reporting, process controls, order exception management, and customer escalations. This role will also provide operational inputs, data analysis, customer and service insights, risk visibility, and execution support to leadership for network planning, budget development, partner governance, and material service, cost, compliance, or performance escalations.

**Responsibilities**

* **Fulfillment Network Operations & 3PL Management**
  + Support daily fulfillment operations across a growing multi-node distribution network, ensuring accurate order execution, capacity readiness, inventory flow, cost discipline, and consistent partner follow-through.
  + Manage weekly and monthly 3PL operating cadences, including partner meetings, KPI reviews, action-item tracking, QBR content preparation, performance follow-up, corrective action tracking, SLA monitoring, root-cause analysis, and readiness checkpoints.
  + Create, maintain, and continuously improve scalable SOPs, process controls, compliance requirements, and partner playbooks covering receiving, inventory control, order release, allocation, pick/pack/ship execution, exception management, and partner escalation paths, ensuring consistent execution across distribution nodes and customer channels.
  + Support fulfillment budget management by preparing invoice audits, spend analysis, productivity tracking, cost-per-order or cost-per-case reporting, and cost-reduction recommendations across the partner network.
* **Order Management & Allocation**
  + Manage order allocation across wholesale, retail, eCommerce, and other channels, balancing customer requirements, inventory availability, freight efficiency, production constraints, and service commitments.
  + Partner with Sales, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Customer Supply Chain, and Operations to execute customer requirements, manage order flow constraints, support inventory positioning decisions, and provide cost-to-serve inputs.
  + Drive proactive exception management for constrained inventory, customer allocation decisions, backorder risk, order holds, shipment readiness, and cross-functional communication.
* **Customer Service**
  + Lead day-to-day customer service for wholesale, retail, distributor, and eCommerce accounts, serving as the operational link between Chomps' fulfillment network and its customers. Oversee order status and shipment inquiries, the shared Customer Service inbox, and open-order review, catching PO issues (pricing errors, MOQ shortfalls, unapproved NetSuite POs, missed ship-by dates) before shipment.
  + Set the team's structure and standards, including priorities, ownership boundaries, escalation paths, channel coverage, backup plans, a shared tracker, and an SOP library. Define and monitor KPIs such as inbox response time, on-time weekly PO updates, PO issue resolution time, OTIF, and fill rate.
  + Serve as the primary supply chain point of contact for key customers, supporting business reviews and new-customer onboarding. Partner with Sales, Account Management, Planning, and Quality to resolve customer issues and deliver weekly PO status updates, cut and delay notices, post-allocation ETAs, key-account update files, and customer portal PO approvals.
  + Own processes for PO revisions, cancellations, and expedites; UDRs, shortages, damages, and returns; and chargebacks, deductions, and disputes, with clear ownership from intake through resolution. Manage retailer compliance (routing guides, vendor manuals, labeling mandates, ASN accuracy, EDI readiness, and appointment scheduling) to protect OTIF and minimize penalties.
  + Turn customer feedback and performance trends into process improvements, driving root-cause analysis and corrective action with 3PLs, carriers, and internal teams to reduce chargebacks, shorten PO-to-delivery cycle time, and manage cost-to-serve. Partner with Planning on retailer demand signals, In-Stock %, Weeks of Supply, and CPFR with key accounts.
* **Technology, Reporting & KPIs**
  + Support business-side execution of order management and fulfillment automation improvements, including reducing manual touches, improving order accuracy, strengthening exception workflows, supporting UAT, driving adoption, and increasing visibility across systems and 3PL partners.
  + Partner with Digital Transformation, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, and 3PL technology teams on NetSuite and partner-system improvements, including requirements, EDI/API integrations, order routing logic, reporting, issue tracking, and operational controls.
  + Own fulfillment scorecards and KPI reporting across service, cost, compliance, productivity, inventory flow, automation adoption, customer requirements, and partner performance, converting recurring issues into corrective action plans, partner follow-up, leadership-ready updates, and prioritized improvement recommendations.
  + Build ad hoc analyses that identify service risks, cost drivers, recurring partner issues, customer compliance exposure, inventory constraints, and opportunities for process improvement.
* **Launch Readiness**
  + Manage operational readiness for fulfillment, ensuring 3PL processes, documentation flows, lot traceability, shipment readiness, customer requirements, and exception management are defined and consistently executed.
  + Coordinate operational launch readiness for new customers, channels, facilities, lanes, and market launches by confirming people, processes, systems, inventory, documentation, partner capabilities, and escalation paths are aligned before go-live.
* **People & Cross-Functional Leadership**
  + Guide, coach, and develop customer service and fulfillment team members as applicable, and influence cross-functional stakeholders, by reinforcing clear ownership, operating rhythms, priorities, and expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined follow-through.
  + Partner with cross-functional teams and external partners to align on execution priorities, resolve constraints, and support fulfillment growth.
  + Translate business growth priorities into practical execution plans, partner requirements, system needs, process controls, and team readiness actions.
  + Provide operational insights, data-backed recommendations, implementation support, and disciplined follow-through to support leadership decisions related to network planning, transportation, contracts, budgets, partner performance, and risk response.

**Who You Are**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment, distribution planning, customer supply chain, logistics, or 3PL operations, including experience managing complex multi-node distribution networks and customer-facing operational process.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 3PL partners, operational KPIs, QBRs, corrective actions, SLA follow-up, and fulfillment performance across multiple facilities or business channels.
* Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, EDI, API, and order management systems; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to identify, design, and implement automation or process improvement opportunities that improve order accuracy, reduce manual work, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen operational visibility.
* Highly analytical and comfortable using data to make recommendations on allocation, cost-to-serve, service risk, inventory positioning, readiness gaps, and partner performance.
* Strong understanding of fulfillment and supply chain metrics, including OTIF, fill rate, order cycle time, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, cost-per-order or cost-per-case, 3PL SLA performance, chargeback exposure, and capacity utilization.
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence Sales, Planning, Finance, Operations, Quality, Digital Transformation, and external partners without always having direct authority.
* Comfortable operating at both planning and execution levels, moving from operational readiness and issue resolution to SOP development, partner follow-up, and process improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communicator with the ability to translate operational complexity into clear recommendations, leadership-ready updates, and partner-facing expectations.
* Entrepreneurial, proactive, and process-oriented; energized by building scalable systems, improving ways of working, and creating structure in a high-growth environment.
* Demonstrated p[eople leadership experience, including coaching, prioritization, ownership setting, and development of team members.
* Willingness to travel up to 30% to distribution centers, partner sites, customer meetings, and cross-functional business reviews.

Description:
When you care deeply about the work you do, it’s rewarding to see it through from concept to completion. We partner with clients to provide both program management and construction management to strategize, plan, and implement projects that drive organizations forward. From hospitals and airports to university campuses, mass transit systems, water treatment facilities, mines, and wind farms, we've successfully managed thousands of projects.

We are strategizing, planning, and implementing projects that help clients achieve their organization’s objectives. Join our award-winning program management team and bring transformational project solutions to life.

Your Opportunity

Stantec is seeking qualified candidates for a Program Controls Advisory Services Manager position. The individual serves as a senior advisor to major capital programs, providing strategic Program Controls leadership during program mobilization, execution, transformation and periods of performance challenge.

The role operates at the intersection of client needs, Program Management and Program Controls, translating client objectives into practical governance, processes, systems, reporting and decision-making frameworks. Unlike a traditional Program Controls Manager focused on day-to-day delivery for one program, this role is deployed where specialized leadership, independent perspective or intervention is required.

The position establishes new controls organizations, assesses and strengthens existing programs, resolves complex delivery issues, improves underperforming controls environments and supports program leadership in restoring confidence, integration and predictability. It also acts as a trusted bridge among the client, PMO, delivery partners, consultants, contractors and internal controls teams.

This position requires prior experience working on an integrated program team with strong knowledge and hands-on experience in developing baseline project budgets and schedules; monitoring and tracking the progress of project work relative to established budgets and schedules; preparation of project budget and schedule status reports and presentations; working with Program/Project Managers to proactively identify project budget and schedule problems and implement corrective actions; and preparation of cost accruals, estimates to complete and estimates at completion.

Qualified candidates understand the process of administering the non-technical elements of large projects that are tied together for the successful delivery of a program. They are comfortable developing and maintaining procedures that help streamline project controls processes and provide mentorship to other project controls specialists and team members. They possess emotional intelligence and prioritize establishing and maintaining trusting relationships and close partnerships with Program/Project Managers, other team members and supporting them in serving the client and meeting established goals to achieve success

Your Key Responsibilities

Program Mobilization and Setup

* Advise clients and program leadership on fit-for-purpose Program Controls operating models for major capital programs.
* Develop governance frameworks for cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting, funding, performance measurement and reporting.
* Establish integrated WBS, CBS, OBS, control accounts, coding structures, baselines, calendars, reporting cycles, roles, responsibilities and approval authorities.
* Develop Program Controls Plans, procedures, SOPs, workflows, responsibility matrices and reporting standards.
* Evaluate and recommend PMIS, scheduling, cost, risk and business-intelligence solutions, including Primavera P6, Primavera Unifier, e-Builder, Power BI and enterprise ERP platforms.
* Create scalable controls that mature across planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and closeout.

Program Controls Advisory

* Serve as a senior advisor to Program Directors, Program Managers, PMO leaders and client executives on program performance and controls strategy.
* Independently assess whether controls are producing reliable information that management can use with confidence.
* Translate complex controls data into executive-level insight on current status, forecast direction, changes, risks and required decisions.
* Challenge ineffective practices and recommend practical improvements aligned with program maturity, complexity, risk profile, contracting strategy and delivery model.

Program Intervention and Issue Resolution

* Rapidly assess controls maturity and identify root causes of performance issues.
* Evaluate schedule quality, cost performance, forecast reliability, risk exposure, change governance, funding alignment and reporting effectiveness.
* Identify breakdowns among cost, schedule, risk, change, funding, contracts and program decision-making.
* Develop and lead targeted recovery and corrective-action plans with clear owners, milestones and performance indicators.
* Resolve unclear ownership, inconsistent processes, disconnected data, reporting gaps and ineffective functional interfaces.
* Stabilize underperforming controls environments and remain engaged long enough to embed sustainable improvements.

Client Services and Client Advocacy

* Serve as a trusted advisor between the client and the program delivery organization.
* Understand client objectives, funding constraints, governance requirements, risk tolerance and performance expectations.
* Translate client needs into clear, actionable requirements for the PMO and delivery teams.
* Facilitate difficult conversations involving performance, forecast changes, schedule delays, risk exposure, funding constraints and delivery challenges.
* Provide an objective perspective where client expectations and delivery realities are not aligned.
* Build trust through transparent, data-driven advice while maintaining productive stakeholder relationships.

Program Performance and Integration

Promote an integrated management environment in which Scope -> Schedule -> Cost -> Funding -> Risk -> Change -> Forecast -> Decision operate as a connected system.

* Ensure cost forecasts reflect schedule progression, approved changes and known risks.
* Ensure schedule forecasts consider procurement, funding, contractor capacity and delivery constraints.
* Connect quantified risk exposure with contingency and management reserve strategies.
* Improve consistency between project-level and program-level reporting.
* Develop forward-looking indicators that identify emerging issues before they become significant performance problems.

Governance and Program Assurance

* Conduct health checks and maturity assessments of Program Controls organizations.
* Assess compliance with procedures and governance expectations, including gaps between documented and actual practices.
* Establish escalation thresholds, decision rights and approval authorities.
* Support executive governance forums with concise, decision-oriented performance information.
* Review data quality and reporting reliability before information is elevated to client executives.
* Support independent program reviews, recovery initiatives and performance-improvement efforts.

Leadership and Capability Building

* Mentor Program Controls Managers and professionals across cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting and reporting disciplines.
* Coach program leadership on using controls information for timely decisions.
* Establish clear interfaces among PMO leadership, controls functions, delivery teams and clients.
* Build collaborative multidisciplinary teams and reduce functional silos.
* Develop repeatable standards, frameworks, templates and leading practices for deployment across programs.
* Plan knowledge transfer so improvements remain with the program after the advisory engagement ends.

Typical Engagements

* A new multi-year capital program needs its controls organization established.
* A PMO is being formed, reorganized or transitioned.
* A client needs an independent assessment of Program Controls.
* Forecasts or schedules are not credible, consistent or decision-ready.
* Projects report differently, preventing program-level visibility.
* Risk, contingency, funding and change are disconnected from cost and schedule.
* Leadership does not trust dashboards or performance reporting.
* Systems are fragmented, overly complex or underutilized.
* Client and Program Management expectations have become misaligned.
* A program requires stabilization, turnaround, recovery or knowledge transfer.

The successful candidate should:

* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Have the demonstrated ability to encourage and facilitate collaboration and cooperation amongst diverse team members
* Schedule and lead coordination meetings
* Work in a manner to ensure personal safety and that of fellow employees by following company health and safety guidelines and policies.
* Consistently adhere to Company processes and policies including business conduct, cyber-security, safety and personal conduct.

It is expected the successful candidate will have the following qualifications:

* Combination of a degree from an accredited institution in an applicable field or documented experience specific to program controls
* BA/BS Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Finance, Project Management or a related discipline.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred
* Additional certifications, PgMP, PMI-SP, PMI-RMP, PMI-CP, CPA, CCM, PE, FE, or similar certifications is preferred
* A minimum of 15 years’ progressive experience supporting complex capital programs, including substantial Program/Project Controls leadership experience infrastructure/buildings/utility/water programs is required
* Familiarity with various project delivery methods, including Design Bid Build, Progressive Design Build, CMAR, and Design Build.
* Demonstrated success establishing, transforming or leading Program Controls functions on major infrastructure or capital programs.
* Strong knowledge of cost management, forecasting, scheduling, risk and opportunity management, change management, funding and cash-flow planning, performance reporting, PMIS/ERP environments and program assurance.
* Experience in the municipal sector in areas of public works, utilities, transportation, and industry and on multi-sector programs is preferred

Title: Director, Project Management
Description:
Everest Clinical Research (“Everest”) is a full-service contract research organization (CRO) providing a broad range of expertise-based clinical research services to worldwide pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. We serve some of the best-known companies and work with many of the most advanced drugs, biologics, and medical devices in development today.

Everest has been an independent CRO since 2004 with a strong foundation as a statistical and data management center of excellence. Building on this foundation, Everest has successfully developed and established itself as a full-service CRO. Everest’s Corporate headquarters are located in Ontario, Canada and US headquarters in New Jersey, USA, with additional physical offices in Asia and Europe.

Everest is known in the industry for its high-quality deliverables, superior customer service, and flexibility in meeting clients’ needs. A dynamic organization with an entrepreneurial origin, Everest continues to experience exceptional growth and great success.

Quality is our backbone, customer-focus is our tradition, flexibility is our strength…that’s us…that’s Everest.

To drive continued success in this exciting clinical research field, we are seeking a committed, skilled, and customer-focused individual to join our winning team as a **Director, Project Management** for our Toronto/Markham, Ontario, Canada on-site location, or remotely from a home-based office anywhere in Canada in accordance with our Work from Home policy.

**Director, Project Management:**

This leadership role will oversee the project planning, communication, and execution of clinical research and development services offered by Everest. Direct reports include all levels and roles within the Project Management department, including Associate Directors, Senior Managers, Managers, Senior Project Managers, Project Managers, Associate Project Managers and Project Coordinators. In-direct reports/subordinates are those Project Managers who are assigned to the tasks on the client studies and projects overseen by the Director of Project Management (matrixed organization).

**JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Plan and implement new client service delivery requests within client portfolio; support evolution of existing client portfolio, providing holistic biometrics and full services (including clinical operations) project deliveries across multiple clinical development programs.
* Strategically align the efforts of functional area directors and managers in project planning, identification of tasks and deliverables, and assessment of resource needs and utilization for existing and new clients/sponsors.
* Perform project and portfolio performance tracking for responsible projects using strategic planning and project tracking methods and tools. Conduct regular project progress reviews with internal teams for assigned portfolios, and facilitate conduct of Everest and Client governance meetings to optimize partnership expectations and performance.
* Check and ensure that responsible projects carried out at Everest are properly tracked and managed according to Everest’s quality, operational and financial budget standards. Support solution and budget development for complex and unique projects and scope to address client requirements.
* Provide leadership, training, mentorship, and management oversight of project management staff. This may include mentorship and training of team members to deliver project management services for specific client portfolios, or mentorship and career development of individuals in a line management capacity.
* In consultation with the senior Project Management leadership, review new Project Management Applicants and recommend hires for interview processing.
* In consultation with the senior Project Management leadership, further develop and establish policies and Standard Operating Procedures in project management for assurance of quality deliverables. Continue to support the development, update, and review of governing documents and WIs for the department.
* Initiate, drive, and support project management departmental process and technology improvement initiatives. Lead and contribute to developing reusable project management templates and training materials that can be used to improve effectiveness and efficiency of project delivery by other team members.
* Through the periodic project/portfolio review meetings, effectively identify issues such as lack of planning, lack of resources, poor team performance, or other external factors negatively impacting the ongoing projects, and bring the issues and solutions to the attention of the functional area directors and managers. Work with the functional area directors and managers to jointly ensure smooth project starting up, continuation, and successful completion.
* In consultation with Everest functional leaders and senior project management leadership, interact with clients for strategic partnership governance activities, which includes but is not limited to project pipeline and delivery planning, measuring performance metrics for the portfolio, identifying new project/service opportunities within the existing portfolio, implementing performance improvement and innovation initiatives, and obtaining key information to aid in the projection of resource requirements and project management purposes.
* Manage all project management aspects of assigned Phase I -IV clinical trials and in accordance with ICH guidelines, FDA, Health Canada, EMA, and other applicable regulatory and legal requirements.
* Lead cross-functional project teams. Manage the planning, implementation, conduct, and reporting of assigned projects within the established timelines and budgets, and with the quality and requirements necessary for regulatory approvals.
* Proactively track and manage project tasks against timelines and hours spent/budgets, alert management when there are risks of having major deviations. Proactively track and manage the financial status against budget and reconcile expenses across sub-streams of activities.
* Function as senior level facilitator of problem solving and conflict resolution, and act as a 2nd level escalation resource.
* Conduct “lessons learned” meetings with project team members to learn from failures and prevent same from future projects.
* Contribute and/or participate in the performance evaluation of staff who performed under the responsible projects.
* When required, this position may assist the organization in responding to and preparing for RFI and RFPs, and subsequently leading and participating in bid defense meetings, defining work scopes and budgets, and leading contract administration activities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in life sciences or health related field.
* A minimum of 18 years of experience in clinical research and development within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, institutional, or CRO setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop others within functional area.
* Demonstrated understanding of cross-functional processes including clinical operations, statistics, data management, pharmacovigilance, subject randomization and drug supply management, data monitoring and adjudication committees, regulatory affairs, and medical writing.
* Knowledge and understanding of ICH guidelines, FDA, Health Canada, and EMA regulations.
* Ability to define scopes and estimate budgets, plan and manage projects, including resource requirements and utilization, hours spent vs. budgets, key deliverables and timelines.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, including setting goals for others and driving to achieve them in accordance with allocated resources, timelines, and budgets.
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Demonstrated strong negotiation and presentation skills.
* Strong ability in problem-solving, including conflict resolution.

  

**Benefits & Compensation:**

We offer a robust benefits package to support your health, well-being, and growth, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, life & AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability, tuition reimbursement, fitness reimbursement, employee assistance program (EAP), a pension plan, generous paid time off and sick leave, and the opportunity to earn a performance based bonus.

To find out more about Everest Clinical Research and to review other opportunities, please visit our website at www.everestclinical.com (http://www.ecrscorp.com).

Estimated Salary Range: $190,000 - 240,000.

We thank all interested applicants, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities, and upon request we will provide accommodations for candidates participating in any part of our recruitment and selection process.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description**

AECOM Buildings + Places is seeking an Operations Manager to support the day-to-day operational performance of our Markham and Mississauga business.

This is a hands-on leadership role focused on translating business priorities into consistent execution. The Operations Manager will work closely with local and regional leadership, project managers, technical leaders, project controls, finance, and other business functions to strengthen project performance, resource management, operational discipline, and overall business effectiveness. This role has been created as a replacement role.

The position will support both the technical practice and operational management of the Markham/Mississauga operation, with particular emphasis on project profitability, client satisfaction, effective project delivery, and efficient business operations.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Support the day-to-day operational management and performance of Buildings + Places in Markham and Mississauga.
* Work with leadership to implement business priorities and maintain consistent operational discipline across the local practice.
* Monitor project and business performance and identify areas requiring management attention or corrective action.
* Support project managers in maintaining strong financial performance, forecasting, cost control, profitability, and delivery discipline.
* Coordinate workload and resource planning to align available staff with current and anticipated project requirements.
* Monitor utilization, staffing requirements, and workload forecasts to identify capacity constraints, underutilization, and emerging resource needs.
* Work closely with project managers, technical leaders, project controls, and finance to improve visibility and accountability for project performance.
* Identify projects requiring additional management attention and coordinate appropriate support and corrective actions.
* Reinforce consistent project management, operational controls, reporting, and business processes.
* Support effective project delivery and client satisfaction by helping teams identify and address operational issues early.
* Facilitate collaboration between the Markham/Mississauga team and the broader Buildings + Places organization to access expertise and resources when required.
* Support business planning and execution of operational priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, reporting, efficiency, and accountability.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and disciplined project delivery.

 **Qualifications**

Minimum Requirements

* Bachelor's degree required + eight (8) years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

* Demonstrated experience in operations, project delivery, project management, business management, project controls, or a related function within a project-based professional services environment.
* Experience supporting the financial and operational performance of projects or a portfolio of projects.
* Strong understanding of project financial management, forecasting, workload planning, resource management, and project delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with project managers, technical professionals, business leaders, and corporate support functions.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to identify operational issues, establish priorities, coordinate corrective actions, and follow issues through to resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and establish accountability across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience within architecture, engineering, consulting, buildings, infrastructure, or a multidisciplinary professional services environment.
* Experience supporting the operations of an office, business unit, or portfolio of projects.
* Experience with project financial performance, resource forecasting, utilization management, and operational reporting.
* Experience supporting project managers in improving project execution and resolving performance challenges.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across technical disciplines and business functions.
* Experience implementing or improving operational processes, management controls, and performance reporting.
* Understanding of the commercial and operational drivers of a consulting and professional services business.

  
**Additional Information**

The Operations Manager will be a visible and engaged member of the Markham/Mississauga Buildings + Places team, providing practical operational support to project managers and technical leaders while reinforcing accountability for project performance and operational discipline.

The role will focus on identifying emerging issues, coordinating the appropriate people and resources, driving follow-through, and supporting leadership in maintaining consistent operational and project management practices across the business.

Title: Senior Manager, Inside Delivery
Description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

#### **What you'll do**

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

* Creating a strategic roadmap and services architecture for how Scout Motors will sell and transact new and used vehicles to retail customers, from purchase through delivery.
* Supporting and driving the definition and design of the ideal transaction process from an operational perspective (documentation, information flows, and third-party integrations).
* Leading vehicle registration compliance efforts across all active and future sales markets, including program build-out, process design, and cross-functional enablement.
* Developing and documenting comprehensive knowledge of vehicle sales and registration requirements across all states, counties, and localities.
* Designing and operationalizing transaction and delivery workflows and an efficient operating model that ensures a scalable, reliable, customer-centric experience.
* Partnering closely with product managers and engineers to translate operational needs into requirements, prioritize improvements, and develop scalable tools and vendor integrations for end-to-end vehicle sales transactions and deliveries, including documentation, payments, financing, registration, and delivery readiness.
* Leading the operational implementation of AI and automation across the transaction and delivery journey, identifying practical use cases that reduce manual work, improve document accuracy, and help customers complete their purchase and prepare for delivery.
* Owning business testing, rollout, and team adoption of new tools, with clear escalation paths and appropriate human review; measuring impact on transaction completion time, accuracy, team productivity, and the customer experience to guide ongoing improvements.
* Creating a technical support model for sales transaction workflows and operating models.
* Coordinating with Finance to define and build systems that accurately recognize vehicle revenue, ensuring alignment between operations and financial reporting.
* Participating in vendor evaluations and providing operational insight for standard operating procedures, transaction policies, and retail training.

**Location & Travel Expectations**:

* This role will be based out of the **Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC**.
* This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
* Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

#### **What you'll bring**

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 10+ years experience managing automotive sales transactions.
* Deep technical acumen and comprehensive regulatory knowledge, especially in vehicle registration and titling requirements.
* Proven experience in early-stage companies: building teams, policies, tools, and pivoting from design to operational execution.
* Experience implementing AI or automation in operational workflows and working closely with product managers and engineers to deliver scalable tools and measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, with a focus on fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to bring together both internal and external teams behind a common vision; skillful at organizational navigation and cross-functional collaboration at all levels; ability to develop effective partnerships and relationships.
* High agency with capability to independently solve problems and develop strategic, sustainable solutions.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

#### **What you'll gain**

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Title: VP, Operations & Patient Experience
Description:
**About Us**

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company — it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

**About the Role**

The VP, Operations & Patient Experience leads the teams that deliver care and support to every LifeMD patient. The role oversees about 150 people across clinical support operations (medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management), the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), and the operations function that keeps the business running (program management, procurement and inventory).

The VP serves as the central hub connecting every part of the business to the patient. Delivering high-quality care depends on ongoing collaboration with marketing, technology, finance, pharmacy and LifeMD's affiliated medical group: aligning patient support capacity with marketing's acquisition and retention plans, shaping the product and technology roadmap around what patients and care teams need, partnering with finance on budgets, KPIs and unit economics, and working with pharmacy and providers so every patient's care, from visit to medication, is seamless.

This is a hands-on operating role for a leader who has run clinical operations at scale. In the coming year, the priorities are using AI and automation to raise productivity across patient support, optimizing every patient touchpoint from onboarding through ongoing care, and lowering the cost of serving each patient.

**Responsibilities**

**Cross-functional Partnership**

* Act as the operational hub between patient-facing teams and the rest of the business, so decisions across every function account for their impact on patient care.
* Partner with marketing on demand forecasts, launches and retention programs, so staffing and support are ready for every patient.
* Partner with technology and product to prioritize platform, workflow and AI improvements based on what patients and care teams need.
* Partner with finance on budgets, operational KPIs and unit economics.
* Partner with LifeMD's pharmacy on fulfillment, shipping and refills, so patients receive their medications reliably and on time.
* Partner with LifeMD's affiliated medical group (PC) on clinical workflows, quality and handoffs between providers and care teams, so care delivery and patient support work as one.

**Clinical Operations**

* Lead clinical support operations, including medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management.
* Partner with medical group leadership on provider capacity, utilization and coverage across sync and async care.
* Manage clinical vendor relationships, contracts and transitions.

**AI and Automation**

* Lead the adoption of AI and automation across patient support and clinical workflows, including AI agents in the patient care center.
* Measure the impact of each deployment on productivity, quality and cost.

**Cost and Unit Economics**

* Own the operations budget and deliver against annual cost targets.
* Drive down the cost of serving each patient through workforce planning, productivity standards and vendor rationalization.
* Set and report operational KPIs in partnership with finance.

**Patient Care Center and Experience**

* Set the strategy and direction for the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), working through its senior director and director, who lead the teams day to day.
* Own patient experience metrics such as resolution, response times and satisfaction, and partner with the business GMs on the on-therapy patient experience.

**Operations and Program Management**

* Run the program management office for cross-functional initiatives, keeping work on schedule and surfacing bottlenecks early.
* Oversee procurement and inventory.

**Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of directors and senior managers, building a strong leadership bench.
* Represent operations and patient experience with the executive team and with external vendors and partners.

  
**Requirements**  

* 10+ years of operations experience, including 5+ years leading multi-layer operations teams (leaders of managers) with large hourly or clinical support workforces.
* Senior leadership experience in healthcare clinical operations, ideally in virtual care, telehealth or a multi-state provider group.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI or automation in operations, with measurable results.
* Proven cost discipline: has owned a large operating budget and reduced costs without sacrificing quality or patient experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executive and board audiences.

**Preferred**

* A clinical background, such as RN, NP or PA, or a clinical operations leadership track.
* Experience leading a contact center at scale.
* Familiarity with multi-state licensing and the regulatory environment for virtual care.

  
**Benefits**  

* Salary: $200,000-250,000 + 15% bonus
* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, Roth 401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Short Term Disability
* Training & Development

Title: Senior Manager, Customer Billing Operations

Lead a critical Customer Billing Operations (CBO) organization responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and compliant billing for Southern California Edison (SCE) customers. As **Senior Manager**, you will lead frontline leaders and operational teams, drive performance across key billing and service commitments, strengthen operational controls and workforce capability, and partner across the organization to resolve complex operational challenges. Employees will participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every four to six weeks), to support IMT activations during emergency events. * Leads the prioritization of strategic planning scenarios which effectively address business challenges while successfully achieving operational performance metrics.
* Defines business metrics, evaluates impact of new and existing initiatives, and initiates and implements changes to improve ongoing operations.
* Administers projects including planning, strategizing, coordination, implementation and quality control. Designs project management systems/tools to facilitate work processes, records management, and communications.
* Oversees the undertaking of data gathering for the development of strategies based upon the market. Oversees the allocation of resources, ensures delivery of sufficient support to a business function.
* A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Five or more years of experience supervising a team of direct reports and/or project management.
* Experience in leading business operations analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in customer operations, billing operations, utility operations, financial operations, or another complex transaction-based operational environment.

Title: Call Center Operations Manager
Description:
**About BlinkRx:**

BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that.

We built RxOS, the first AI-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script.

Our teams solve complex, high-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out-of-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month.

BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80+ billion category, with exceptional momentum:

* **Built for scale:**
  Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale.
* **Proven growth and economics:**
  We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands.
* **Trusted with category-defining programs:**
  Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer’s direct-to-patient platform for its GLP-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows.

We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health.

**The Role:**
The Patient Services Operations team is at the forefront of the company mission to bring affordable prices and deliver the best possible experience for all of our customers. As a Call Center Operations Manager, you won't just oversee a team — you'll set the pace, raise the bar, and build a culture where grit and customer obsession are the standard, not the exception. This is a high-intensity, high-impact role. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution: designing systems that scale, coaching talent that sticks, and using data to drive relentless improvement. When things break — and in a fast-growing company, things break — you'll be the one who figures it out and moves the team forward. You'll collaborate across product, engineering, pharmacy, and business leadership to translate the voice of the customer into real operational and product changes. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a distance.

***This is a full-time, on-site position based in our Pittsburgh (Robinson Twp.) office.***

**What you’ll do:**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of customer service reps and team leads — holding the bar high while investing in each person's growth.
* Drive a performance culture built on accountability, candid feedback, and real development — not just annual reviews.
* Create an environment where people do their best work, feel ownership over outcomes, and genuinely care about the patients they serve.

**Operational Management**

* Own the day-to-day: ensure timely, high-quality resolution of customer issues across all channels (phone, email, chat) — at speed and at scale.
* Tackle complex, ambiguous escalations head-on with sound judgment and customer-first instincts.
* Build and enforce policies, processes, and SLAs that are rigorous but human — protecting the customer experience while enabling a fast-moving team.
* Stay ahead of capacity: monitor workload, adjust staffing, and anticipate surges before they become fires.

**Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Own the metrics that matter — CSAT, NPS, FCR, response time, resolution time — and use them to tell a story, not just report numbers.
* Surface trends in customer behavior and pain points; turn those insights into action with product, engineering, and operations.
* Implement Quality Assurance programs that raise the floor on service quality, every week.

**Process Improvement**

* Relentlessly question the status quo: identify friction in workflows, eliminate steps that slow agents down, and reduce customer effort at every touchpoint.
* Lead improvement initiatives end-to-end — design, pilot, measure, iterate.
* Bring the customer's voice to cross-functional teams, ensuring it shapes product decisions and business strategy.

**Technology & Tools**

* Evaluate, implement, and optimize CRM, ticketing, and support tooling — with a bias toward automation and efficiency.
* Partner with engineering and vendor teams to push system enhancements that keep our support infrastructure ahead of our growth curve.
* Treat data integrity as non-negotiable: if the data isn't clean, the decisions aren't sound.

**A successful applicant will fit the following criteria:**

We want someone who runs toward hard things. You'll thrive here if:

* You have 5+ years of leadership experience in fast-paced, high-volume customer service or call center environments.
* You have 2+ years in customer service, healthcare, pharmacy, or a related field — you understand the stakes when a patient can't get their medication.
* You're a builder of teams and systems — not just a manager of tasks.
* You use data instinctively: you know which metrics to watch, how to find the story in the numbers, and how to translate insights into action.
* You thrive in ambiguity. When priorities shift (and they will), you recalibrate fast and keep the team grounded.
* You communicate with clarity and conviction — up, down, and across the org — and you do it with respect and patience.
* You have a low ego and a high standard. You'll do whatever it takes, including jumping on the phones when the team needs it.
* Spanish bilingual is preferred — for supporting diverse customers and teams.
* You have a bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or equivalent real-world experience.

**Why Join Us:**
It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.
